notes.title: Omega Strikers - Season ∞ Starts! | New Mode: ?!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]HELLO GAMERS[/b][/h1]
The everlasting SEASON has BEGUN!!!

What does that mean, you may ask?
Well, to be honest, nothing [i]that [/i]different from before.
Things that will stop after this season reset:
[list]
[*] New BP levels
[*] New mission rewards
[*] New skins
[/list]
Things I will keep doing:
[list]
[*] Ladder resets
[*] Micropatches
[*] Community emote giveaways (Have a couple more slots to add too. Contest 2?)
[/list]

We also got a couple more plushies coming your way. Any guesses on who's next?! Hehehe

There's no patch notes with this one because we did that a few weeks ago as to no coincide with the big [url=https://nerdstreet.com/events/reach-the-summit-or-omega-strikers-lan-2025-09-20?section=overview]OS LAN in Denver[/url] coming up

(Okay I lied there were a few hotfixes to the last patch I will mention below)

There is a NEW MODE tho!!! More info below the stuff I copy and paste each season.

Alright, let us begin!!
[hr][/hr]

[h1][b]SEASON RESET[/b][/h1][i]NEW SEASON! Season ∞. After this, we're gonna continue to do ladder resets and balance patches and such, but there weren't be like new content like skins, BP rewards, etc, so I'm just calling it Season Everlasting. I mentioned this in the top part but if you skipped that I'm writing it again so you aren't like WAIT WHAT DOES THAT SEASON MEAN??[/i]

Ranked Rewards:[list][*]Aqua Cannon goal explosion[list][*](This isn't a seasonal reward btw, this is a forever thing that you'll unlock once you hit challenger any time in the future.)[*]If you hit challenger and didn’t get this, make a ticket.[/list][*]Top "x" titles[list][*]ex: Top 5, Top 10, Top 25, etc[/list][*]An emote for reaching Platinum[*]An emote for playing a bunch of games[list][*]25 Ranked Games to be exact[/list][*]New Battlepass Levels[list][*]Also please note that after a certain Battlepass level, you can no longer purchase additional levels with Ody points.[/list][/list]Most rewards will be based on your Season *Peak* rating, but the titles for "Top X%" will be based on your leaderboard position at the end of the season. They will go out with ladder resets. 
As always, you can track your progress and match history at our official site at stats.omegastrikers.gg

[h1][b]NEW MODE[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42958178/b3269bce4f180e93522cf200f709ffbd21ffe0d2.png[/img]

I'm loving calling this Chaos Queue.
It will be called ?! in the queue selector because I didn't want to localize it. How smart.
Basically, how it works, is that it serves a different Micropatch from the main game modes.
This allows me to change characters, abilities, cooldowns, base stats, awakenings, gear etc SEPARATELY from the main game mode.

One mode I was testing was stuff like bigger awakening tradeoffs. For example, Quick Strike gives a ton of energy but slows your strikes, Super Surge made your dash shorter but did a LOT more knockback, Heavy Impact would reduce your damage but refresh cooldowns by 80% if you hit them.

Also tested a mode where everyone was Juno but had 20 movespeed but no cooldowns

Also tested a mode where everyone was X and had 1,000 movespeed and huge damaging ults.

Stuff like this.

We can do a lot of stuff that has to do with changing numbers.

Let me know if you have any ideas!
  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42958178/b775708791685446d83785d49befa3174c70d9e8.png[/img]

[h1][b]PATCH NOTES[/b][/h1]
[i]Very quick addendums to the last patch that I fixed the other day[/i]
[list]
[*] Juliette special was still 30s, patch said 35. It's 35 now. Fixed
[*] Rasmus secondary was dealing 160 base dmg. It should've been 120. Fixed
[*] Drek secondary was dealing 9.7% kb to core. Should be 15%. Fixed
[*] Stagger swagger nerfed :: threshold: 40% -> 35%
[*] Quick strike buffed :: Energy: -1 -> -.65
[*] Orb dancer buffed :: Duration 2 -> 2.2s, Speed after 5 stacks: 60% ->  65%
[/list]

[h1][b]Server changes[/b][/h1]
We spun down a couple rarely-used servers in some regions. Shouldn't affect latency for you that much considering there are other nearby servers and they were played on much more frequently. This will not affect US-Central local zones.
[list]
[*] us-west-2 (Oregon)
[*] ca-central-1 (Montreal)
[*] eu-west-1 (Ireland)
[*] ap-northeast-2 (Seoul)
[/list]

notes.title: Omega Strikers - September 4th Micropatch | Update Notes
notes.notes:
[b]Hello GAMERS!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!![/b]
We're approaching Season 7(!) of Omega Strikers, which means it's time to attempt some shakeups to the video game.

We've got some reworked awakenings (familiar faces you haven't seen in a while~) and some of your regular ole' balance changes.

This patch is a little earlier than the season reset itself because there is a LAN tournament around the time of the season reset and if I changed the balance 2 days before the tournament I think I might get attacked irl.

Last but not least, thanks to my patch gang that helped me with this one: AlphaMii, Megaverse, Tanky McTanky, TempoMelon, and weston. 

Okay let us begin

[hr][/hr]

[h1][b]MAP ROTATION[/b][/h1]
[i]I've been doing weekly map rotations (Monday map madness) and posting them in the Discord. Because of that, no map rotations in patch notes.[/i]

[h1][b]STRIKERS[/b][/h1]
[i]As far as Striker changes go, nothing insane here. The overall theme of the patch is essentially trying to balance out speed/damage/core control. It's become sort of search for that sweet spot where damage isn't taking over speed or speed isn't obviously outshining damage.[/i]

[h3][b]Ai.Mi[/b][/h3]
[i]This cat has been quite powerful in all tiers of play, has a good "dash punch" and always allows for flashy plays that are tough to counter. [/i]
[list]
[*]
Cyber Swipe [SECONDARY]
[list]
[*]
Cooldown :: 13s → 15s[/list][/list]
[h3][b]Asher[/b][/h3]
[i]Asher is in a pretty solid place but I still think the "feel" of her gameplay can be improved a touch.[/i]
[list]
[*]
Breakthrough [SECONDARY]
[list]
[*]
Pre-channel cast time .125s → .075s[/list]
[*]
Pathsplitter [SPECIAL]
[list]
[*]
Cooldown: 40s → 35s[/list][/list]
[h3][b]Atlas[/b][/h3]
[i]He's been a little weak, not so much so, but hitting his primary to be a little faster - and therefore longer range - should help him a touch.[/i]
[list]
[*]
Astral Projection [PRIMARY]
[list]
[*]
Speed 2000 → 2286[/list][/list]
[h3][b]Drek'ar[/b][/h3]
[i]Ok I'm putting back his secondary KB stuff but making it hurt less.[/i]
[list]
[*]
Xeno Cloak [Secondary]
[list]
[*]
Core Knockback :: 9.7% → 15%
[*]
Damage 30% → 20%[/list][/list]
[h3][b]Dubu[/b][/h3]
[i]Dubu has been just a little strong in some places, making his slam not deal so much damage should help that.[/i]
[list]
[*]
Somerassault [Secondary]
[list]
[*]
Damage 230 → 200
[list]
[*]
Knockback unchanged[/list][/list][/list]
[h3][b]Era[/b][/h3]
[i]Era still remains like far and away the strongest character. Like by a lot. [/i]
[list]
[*]
Base Stats
[list]
[*]
Stagger :: 1300 → 1200 (Tier 3 → Tier 4)
[*]
Stagger growth :: +425 → +325 (Tier 2 → Tier 4)[/list]
[*]
Bewitching Beam [PRIMARY]
[list]
[*]
Enemy Speed Debuff :: 25%→ 20% [/list][/list]
[h3][b]Finii[/b][/h3]
[i]A little experimental change to the tenacious trickster's Triple Take to make it a little quicker. The cooldown begins after[/i] [i]the skill ends, so making a CD change to account for that as well (and its new power).[/i]
[list]
[*]
Triple Take [SECONDARY]
[list]
[*]
Time between pulses :: 0.4s → 0.3s
[*]
Cooldown :: 11s → 12s[/list][/list]
[h3][b]Juliette[/b][/h3]
[i]Jules could use a little tap to her relatively short CD special to bring her in line.[/i]
[list]
[*]
Flame Flurry [SPECIAL]
[list]
[*]
Cooldown :: 30s → 35s[/list][/list]
[h3][b]Kai[/b][/h3]
[i]A fairly straightforward character, Kai doesn't have a ton of room to adjust things. Giving him a little buff to his primary range to help him feel a little better.[/i]
[list]
[*]
Barrage [PRIMARY]
[list]
[*]
Range :: 650 → 780
[*]
Lifetime :: .375 → .450
[list]
[*]
Lifetime change is needed otherwise the projectiles disappear before reaching intended range[/list][/list][/list]
[h3][b]Kazan[/b][/h3]
[i]Kazan is pretty oppressive in many places, making a small adjustment to his form change so that players have to think just a little more when they want to switch.[/i]
[list]
[*]
Pop-Up / Retract [SPECIAL]
[list]
[*]
Cooldown :: 1s → 1.5s[/list][/list]
[h3][b]Luna[/b][/h3]
[i]Equipped with what I assume are nuclear bombs, Luna has always been capable of pumping tons of damage and launching people and cores all over the place. [/i]
[list]
[*]
B.O.O.S.T. [SECONDARY]
[list]
[*]
Core Knockback :: 1380 + 200% → 1300 + 200%[/list]
[*]
W.H.A.M.M.Y. [PRIMARY]
[list]
[*]
Damage/Knockback :: 220 → 200[/list][/list]
[h3][b]Rasmus[/b][/h3]
[i]Razzy is pretty good in all facets and is kind of a jack-of-all-trades. This should tone him down just a tiny bit to bring him in line.[/i]
[list]
[*]
Whiplash [SECONDARY]
[list]
[*]
Duration :: 2.5s → 2.25s
[*]
Time until recast enabled :: 0.5s → 0.4s[/list][/list]
[h3][b]Rune[/b][/h3]
[i]Little "feeling improvement" buff to Rune to make him TP around a little quicker and pull off some flashy plays.[/i]
[list]
[*]
Shadow Swap [SECONDARY]
[list]
[*]
Projectile Speed :: 3450 → 4000
[list]
[*]
Rune IS the projectile[/list][/list][/list]
[h3][b]Vyce[/b][/h3]
[i]Probably the game's leading damage dealer, Vyce could use just a lil' reduction in that front. [/i]
[list]
[*]
Power Chord [PRIMARY]
[list]
[*]
Damage / Knockback :: 180 → 160[/list]
[*]
Super Nova [SPECIAL]
[list]
[*]
Cooldown :: 35s → 40s[/list][/list]
[h3][b]Zentaro[/b][/h3]
[i]Go ahead, post the ult change screenshot. I dare you. [/i]
[list]
[*]
Slice and Dice [PRIMARY]
[list]
[*]
Cooldown :: 7.5s → 9s[/list]
[*]
Oni's Blade [SPECIAL]
[list]
[*]
Cooldown :: 35s → 36s[/list][/list]

[h1][b]SYSTEMS[/b][/h1]
[i]Little change to Core Flip damage. It was doing a lot of damage and it was kinda wack to just die from a million damage flip. Knockback is unchanged because if you die from flip from being too close to a wall, that's your problem.[/i]

[h3][b]Core Flip (aka Energy Burst)[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]
Base Damage :: 200 → 150
[list]
[*]
Knockback Unchanged[/list][/list]
[h1][b]AWAKENINGS[/b][/h1]
[i]Alright here comes the fun stuff. New rotation with some old friends. The old friends just aren't really how you remember them. I'll be keeping a close watch on how the new awakenings perform in games so if anything becomes crazy and insane or is hot garbage, I can adjust accordingly quickly after.[/i]

[list]
[*]
Rotated out:
[list]
[*]
Prize Fighter
[*]
Recovery Drone
[*]
Orb Replicator
[*]
Team Player
[*]
Fight or Flight
[*]
Stacks on Stacks[/list]
[*]
Rotated in:
[list]
[*]
Knife's Edge [NERFED]
[*]
Big Fish [BUFFED]
[*]
Orb Dancer [NERFED]
[*]
Quick Strike [REWORKED]
[*]
Stagger Swagger [REWORKED]
[*]
Unstoppable [REWORKED][/list][/list]
[h3][b]Big Fish[/b][/h3]
[i]BF moves more in line with the other stagger awakenings. [/i]
[list]
[*]
Gain 22.5% Size and 175 → [b]200 [/b]max Stagger. [/list]
[h3][b]Built Different[/b][/h3]
[i]Giving Built Different a little love to those who are nailing the impacts.[/i]
[list]
[*]
Gain 22.5% → [b]20% [/b]Size. Your IMPACT abilities hit 5% → [b]7%[/b] harder (1% on Core). [/list]
[h3][b]Dead Eye[/b][/h3]
[i]Moving Dead Eye to being more of a reward for long range characters.[/i]
[list]
[*]
Hit 25% harder (6.5% to Core) against enemies at 525+ → [b]600+[/b] range. [/list]
[h3][b]Knife's Edge[/b][/h3]
[i]One of the awakenings I frequently hear yapped about. This should move it down a bit. Did you know there can be a modifier on the Knife's Edge effect in your own goal arc?[/i]
[list]
[*]
Gain 30 Power and 30% Speed whenever you're within 400 → [b]250[/b] range of the Arena's edge. [/list]
[h3][b]Missile Propulsion[/b][/h3]
[i]Missile Prop is kind of a "do everything a little too well" type awakening.[/i]
[list]
[*]
PROJECTILES gain 70% travel or cast range and hit 22.5% → [b]17.5%[/b] harder (4.5% to Core). [/list]
[h3][b]Orb Dancer[/b][/h3]
[i]My vision of Orb Dancer is that it grants a big burst of speed when you pick up an orb allowing you to reposition better rather than just giving you a bunch of speed for like an hour (it used to be as long as a Kai secondary and it was FASTER!)[/i]
[list]
[*]
Power Orbs increase Speed by 30% for 4.5s. → [b]2s[/b] After collecting 5 without being KOed, this effect is increased to 55% → [b]60%[/b]. [/list]
[h3][b]Quick Strike[/b][/h3]
[i]Rework alert. Quick Strike has been gone for a while because it was just like insane and good and insane. This should make it still good but has an interesting trade-off that you gotta think about.[/i]
[list]
[*]
Strike cooldown reduced by 20% → [b]15%[/b]. Strike hits grant 1 → [b]-1[/b] additional Energy. 
[list]
[*]
So base strike does [b]not[/b] grant energy at all. Abilities still do. X's SPECIAL still does.[/list][/list]
[h3][b]Stagger Swagger[/b][/h3]
[i]Rework alert. Stagger Swagger is actually losing the Stagger part of its name. I think we should just pretend it is called "Swagger" now. [/i]
[list]
[*]
Gain 5% → [b]6%[/b] Speed. While below 50% → [b]40%[/b] Stagger, this effect increases to 15% → [b]30%[/b] and you heal 150 → [b]0[/b] Stagger per second, including while in the Staggered state. 
[list]
[*]
The tooltip for this may be incorrect, saying it will be triggered under [b]60%.[/b]
[list]
[*]
I'm working on fixing this but I can't update tooltips in a micropatch.[/list][/list][/list]
[h3][b]Twin Drive[/b][/h3]
[i]That's a 5% increase.[/i]
[list]
[*]
SECONDARY gains +1 charge and has 2% → [b]2.1%[/b] decreased cooldown. [/list]
[h3][b]Unstoppable[/b][/h3]
[i]Rework alert. Making unstoppable more stoppable but more of an anti-damage tool.[/i]
[list]
[*]
Gain a shield that protects you from 100% of the damage and 100% → [b]30%[/b] knockback from the first hit you take. This shield recharges at the start of each round and after 6.5s of not getting hit.
[list]
[*]
Shield lingers for 0.1s → [b]0.75s[/b] (Not mentioned in tooltip)
[list]
[*]
Cooldown begins [i]after[/i] linger time ends.  [/list][/list][/list]
[h1][b]GEAR[/b][/h1]
[h3][b]Eject Button[/b][/h3]
[i]Little experimental change. Adjusting a hidden modifier to make JUST the HASTE effectiveness improved. [/i]
[list]
[*]
Gain 50% DASH range, BLINK range, and 50% → [b]55%[/b] HASTE effectiveness, and 15% reduced SECONDARY cooldown. After casting your SECONDARY, recast it within 3.25s → [b]3s[/b] to BLINK back to the cast position
[list]
[*]
HASTE change will be unnoted in tooltip. [/list][/list]

notes.title: Omega Strikers - July 8th Micropatch | Update Notes
notes.notes:
[b]Welcome Back Gamers[/b]

Season 6 is well underway and, following that fat patch from last month or so, we want to make a couple modifications to the stuff that we changed in the aforementioned big fat patch. Outside of that, there aren't a ton of other things we're adding at this point. (No second emote contest yet, sad.) 
But I'm still cooking up some goodies headed your way! (New plush soon tm?) 
And, of course, thanks to my patch gang that helped me with this one: threezybreezy, MothHoney, Rayboyp, and Snake.

[h1][b]MAP ROTATION[/b][/h1]
[i]I've been doing weekly map rotations (Monday map madness) and posting them in the Discord. Because of that, no map rotations in patch notes this time. [/i][i]I'm also thinking about just turning on ALL THE MAPS at the same time for a little bit. How does that feel? Let me know it in the comments below or on Discord or on Reddit or whatever.[/i]
[h1][b]STRIKERS[/b][/h1]
[i]Last patch we shook up a lot of things. The cast were mostly in pretty good spots but there were a handful of outliers and strikers that weren't really in line with the rest of em. These adjustments should mostly even things out a bit.[/i]
[h3][b]Asher[/b][/h3]
[i]Asher got hit with a somewhat large usability nerf last patch with the self slow. This should alleviate some of those pains while keeping her strength relatively similar.[/i]
[list]
[*]
Barrier Beam [PRIMARY]
[list]
[*]
Self slow :: 60% → 45%[/list][/list]
[h3][b]Atlas[/b][/h3]
[i]He's in pretty good shape following the nerf, but we can afford to show him just a little love for like the longest CD ability in the whole game.[/i]
[list]
[*]
Celestial Intervention [SPECIAL]
[list]
[*]
Healing :: 25% → 30%[/list][/list]
[h3][b]Drek'ar[/b][/h3]
[i]This is just to tone down some of his cheesy maneuvers that are kinda WACK.[/i]
[list]
[*]
Xeno Cloak [Secondary]
[list]
[*]
Core Knockback :: 15% → 9.7%[/list][/list]
[h3][b]Era[/b][/h3]
[i]Following the cast time buff and some other things, Era was easily the biggest winner of the last patch. This should tone her down but still let her meaningfully interact with the game.[/i]
[list]
[*]
Bewitching Beam [PRIMARY]
[list]
[*]
Debuff :: 2s → 1.75s[/list]
[*]
Flutter Fly [SECONDARY]
[list]
[*]
Speed :: 52.5% → 45%[/list][/list]
[h3][b]Estelle[/b][/h3]
[i]A light tap to Estelle primary while allowing for more cool Rose Warp plays.[/i]
[list]
[*]
Piercing Shot [PRIMARY]
[list]
[*]
Cooldown :: 9s → 9.5s[/list]
[*]
Rose Warp [SECONDARY]
[list]
[*]
Cooldown :: 17s → 16s[/list][/list]
[h3][b]Finii[/b][/h3]
[i]Finii has been pretty good, even with a nerf that hit her in the last patch. She was on the radar so we'll tone her down a bit more.[/i]
[list]
[*]
Misdirection [PRIMARY]
[list]
[*]
Cooldown :: 7s → 8s[/list]
[*]
Triple Take [SECONDARY]
[list]
[*]
Range :: 900 → 850
[*]
Damage Dealt by Allies :: 25% → 30% [/list][/list]
[h3][b]Juliette[/b][/h3]
[i]Outperforming the other KO greedy strikers, Jules needs just a little touch to keep her in line. [/i]
[list]
[*]
Base Stats
[list]
[*]
Power :: 110 → 100[/list][/list]
[h3][b]Juno[/b][/h3]
[i]Juno is tossing her friends around and dealing damage and killing people and being generally super annoying.[/i]
[list]
[*]
Friend Fling [PRIMARY]
[list]
[*]
Cooldown :: 7.5s → 8s
[*]
Knockback / Damage :: 200 + 100% → 200 + 90%[/list][/list]
[h3][b]Octavia[/b][/h3]
[i]Octy is a game warping character. Her recent nerfs have kept her in check but she has a little bit of room to grow still. [/i]
[list]
[*]
Sonic Boom [PRIMARY]
[list]
[*]
Cooldown :: 10s → 9s[/list][/list]
[h1][b]AWAKENINGS[/b][/h1]
[i]The awakening rotation is pretty solid atm. A lot of the more troublesome awakenings are out, but where's the fun if you can't be troublesome sometimes? A handful of adjustments here and some awakenings are getting tiny reworks so we'll see how those feel as well. [/i]
[list]
[*]
Rotated out:
[list]
[*]
Reptile Remedy
[*]
Big Fish
[*]
Among Titans[/list]
[*]
Rotated in:
[list]
[*]
Demolition
[*]
Siege Machine
[*]
Peak Performance [NERFED][/list][/list]
[h3][b]Adrenaline Rush[/b][/h3]
[i]Small rework alert! Giving a higher base CD reduction so it feels better to deny, nerfing the wild speed boost it gives.[/i]
[list]
[*]
Ability cooldowns reduced by 1s → [b]1.5s[/b]. Earning a Takedown increases Speed by 40% for 8s → [b]7s[/b] and reduces current cooldowns by 10s → [b]8s[/b].[/list]
[h3][b]Bulk Up[/b][/h3]
[i]Moving the oft overperforming bulky boy in line with the rest of the stagger awakenings.[/i]
[list]
[*]
Gain 350 → [b]300[/b] max Stagger and 1.75 → [b]1.5[/b] Power per 100 max Stagger. [/list]
[h3][b]Extra Special[/b][/h3]
[i]Watch as I slightly wipe away the smirk on the face of the happy star.[/i]
[list]
[*]
SPECIAL cooldown reduced by 30% → [b]25%[/b]. Each face off its cooldown is reset. [/list]
[h3][b]One-Two Punch[/b][/h3]
[i]One + Two. That's how much power I'm removing from it. [/i]
[list]
[*]
Hit 23% → [b]20%[/b] harder (12% to Core) against targets you've hit within 1.5s.[/list]
[h3][b]Peak Performance[/b][/h3]
[i]Back in the rotation, Peak is pretty peak in terms of power - especially with the other stuff coming in this patch.[/i]
[list]
[*]
Gain 350 → [b]300 [/b]max Stagger and 0.55% → [b]0.50%[/b] Speed per 100 max Stagger. [/list]
[h3][b]Prize Fighter[/b][/h3]
[i]Small rework alert 2! More stacks required to get to max, but less power per KO.[/i]
[list]
[*]
Begin each set with 1 Prize Fighter stack, granting 23 → [b]18[/b] Power. Takedowns grant 1 Prize Fighter stack (max 3 → [b]4[/b] stacks), but getting K.O.'d removes 1 stack. Stacks reset (to 1) between sets. [/list]
[h3][b]Spark of Strength[/b][/h3]
[i]Spark of Strength was kinda overperforming compared to the other members of its spark gang[/i]
[list]
[*]
SPARK - Gain 4 Power, plus 20 → [b]18[/b] per SPARK you have. [/list]
[h3][b]Stinger[/b][/h3]
[i]Stinger is still ass in every tier[/i]
[list]
[*]
Normal hits deal bonus damage equal to 11% → [b]12%[/b] (Light hits 3%) of enemies' max Stagger over 3.5s → [b]3.75s. [/b][/list]
[h3][b]Super Surge[/b][/h3]
[i]The strength in this mostly lies in its range but it could use a little touch to its damage.[/i]
[list]
[*]
DASH range, BLINK range, and HASTE effects increased 75%. These abilities hit 30% → [b]25% [/b]harder (7.5% → [b]8%[/b] to Core). [/list]
[h1][b]GEAR[/b][/h1]
[h3][b]Magnetized Soles[/b][/h3]
[i]A troublesome gear, I'm trying a little rework to how Mag soles functions. The gear is often kinda used best when like straddling the midline which isn't my favorite paradigm. This will give you speed for a bit longer but won't be as effective if you keep refreshing it.[/i]
[list]
[*]
Crossing Midfield grants 20% → [b]14%[/b] Speed for 1.5s → [b]1.8s[/b].[/list]
[h3][b]Momentum Boots[/b][/h3]
[i]Mom boots got a sizable buff last patch and as a result was doing pretty well. I like how it emerged as a contended but I don't want it to overshadow other selections. This is a bit of an experimental change to see how the ramping speed effects the people who are good with it so I'll keep an eye on it.[/i]
[list]
[*]
Gain 5% Speed plus up to 15% → [b]13%[/b] over 12s → [b]10s[/b] (1.3% Movement Speed per Stack). Getting hit resets the added effect.[/list]
[h3][b]Powerhouse Pauldrons[/b][/h3]
[i]Pauldrons is quite a niche pick, but when it's picked correctly, it does pretty well. While I do want people to be rewarded for picking correctly in niche situations, I don't want it to be like. Super good.[/i]
[list]
[*]
Gain 30% size, 25 → [b]20[/b] power, and 20% damage reduction. [/list]
[h3][b]Siphoning Wand[/b][/h3]
[i]Not really a great pick in most situations and kind of an average pick in situations where it could be good. Giving the wand a lil love.[/i]
[list]
[*]
Hits deal bonus damage equal to 6% → [b]7%[/b] of the enemies max Stagger over 2.5s → [b]2s[/b] (2% for Light hits), heal yourself for 125% of that amount. [/list]
[h3][b]Vicious Vambrace [/b][/h3]
[i]Vambrace has fallen to the wayside, despite survivability changes. This should help it out a bit while making sure strikers aren't just straight up unkillable. Hopefully.[/i]
[list]
[*]
Restore Stagger equal to 45% → [b]50%[/b] of the damage you deal (10% on Core). [/list]

notes.title: Omega Strikers - Season 6 Update | May 15th Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h1][b]HELLO GAMERS[/b][/h1]
It is now Season 6 so we got a bit of a shakeup to things in the patch notes today.

Along with some pretty big changes aimed at mixing up the meta, we also got a sick new skin for the gamers who reach gold, some new battlepass levels, some new missions with new emotes, and the winners of the community emote contest!! So even MORE emotes!!!!

Today’s balance changes were also brought in part of my randomly selected micropatch volunteer squad: lyarri, Cardsmith, and Wallaby Gangsta. Shouts out to them.

Alright, let us begin!!
[hr][/hr]

[h1][b]SEASON RESET[/b][/h1][i]NEW SEASON! We’re now in Season 6! Crazy how it be like that. It feels like only yesterday it was season 0 and Rune was new. Speaking of new - we got new missions, a new skin, new emotes, all that jazz. I’m a big fan of the Finii skin tbh.[/i]

Ranked Rewards:[list][*]Aqua Cannon goal explosion[list][*](This isn't a seasonal reward btw, this is a forever thing that you'll unlock once you hit challenger any time in the future.)[*]If you hit challenger and didn’t get this, make a ticket.[/list][*]Top "x" titles[list][*]ex: Top 5, Top 10, Top 25, etc[/list][*]Finii Recolor[list][*]“Dark Circus Finii”[*]For anyone who reaches Gold![/list][*]An emote for reaching Platinum[*]An emote for playing a bunch of games[list][*]25 Ranked Games to be exact[/list][*]New Battlepass Levels[list][*]Also please note that after a certain Battlepass level, you can no longer purchase additional levels with Ody points.[/list][/list]Most rewards will be based on your Season *Peak* rating, but the titles for "Top X%" will be based on your leaderboard position at the end of the season.As always, you can track your progress and match history at our official site at stats.omegastrikers.gg

There were also tons of dumb ones……. looking at you who just submitted a 512x512 PNG of my own face. Since there were so many good ones, I had trouble just picking two. I’ll be giving out codes to the creators so they can use them and give them out to their friends first, but the emotes will be made availiable by redemption code shortly.

Unfortunately, due to a bug, they won’t be displayed on consoles. If someone on console uses it or sees it, it will just display the default thumbs up. Sorry about that, but we are looking into it! 

[h1][b]MAP ROTATION[/b][/h1][i]I’ve been doing weekly map rotations (Monday map madness) and posting them in the Discord. Because of that, no map rotations in patch notes this time. [/i]

[h1][b]STRIKERS[/b][/h1][i]We made a big pass at a lot of Strikers. Some big changes and even a couple “fundamental” shifts for some Strikers in particular. There are a couple big swings at stuff here so I’ll be monitoring it closely and will swiftly make some adjustments if something becomes too insane one way or the other.[/i]

[h3][b]Asher[/b][/h3][i]Asher has been a staple of competitive play for eons. She holds it down, drags you out of the arena like a crying baby, checkmates like no other, and her secondary even files your taxes. This should tone down more unhealthy aspects of her kit and cement her identity as a lockdown beast.[/i][list][*]Base Stats[list][*]Power :: 115 → 110[/list][*]Barrier Beam [PRIMARY][list][*]Self slow :: 30% → 60%[/list][*]Breakthrough [SECONDARY][list][*]Knockback Reduction :: 30% → 0%[*]Buff Duration :: 5s → 2.5s[*]Cooldown: 14.5s → 13.5s[/list][/list][h3][b]Atlas[/b][/h3][i]Atlas, as an astral being, is all about spacing minigames… so let him participate in them! He's not a basketball version of a Blue Lock AI, he should be an ACTIVE participant. [/i][list][*]Astral Projection [PRIMARY][list][*]Lifetime :: .7 → .6 (Effective range :: 480 → 420)[/list][/list][h3][b]Drek'ar[/b][/h3][i]Drek'ar is losing some awakenings in this patch. He’s already a bit of a menace in solo queue so we’re being a little cautious. His ability to threaten molten bolt snipes is also being buffed while keeping the damage the same overall if you're spamming the button off cooldown.[/i][list][*]Molten Bolt [SPECIAL][list][*]Cooldown :: 35s → 30s[*]Damage per tick :: 20 → 17[*]Power ratio per tick :: 10% → 8.5%[/list][/list][h3][b]Era[/b][/h3][i]The era of Era has been gone for a long time. She still sees some niche play, but this adjustment should make her beams more consistent and allow her to win more interactions in high speed games. She can become rather bewitching quickly, and this change is somewhat experimental, so I’ll be keeping[/i] [i]an eye on her to make sure she's not flying too far past the other speedy midfielders.[/i][list][*]Bewitching Beam [PRIMARY][list][*]Pre-cast lockout time :: 0.4 → 0.2s[/list][/list][h3][b]Estelle[/b][/h3][i]Blink lasering, known to some as the ‘quangle’, is a little too easy and rewarding and Estelle’s flex potential in all three roles is quite high. This little touch should reduce her flexibility a bit without impacting her midfield power fantasy of finding the perfect stunning snipe.[/i][list][*]Rose Warp [SECONDARY][list][*]Damage and Knockback :: 140 → 120[/list][/list][h3][b]Finii[/b][/h3][i]Finii is already quite good. A small nerf on the lowest cooldown secondary in the game should ensure she's not too overwhelming in the context of the other goalie changes happening while still letting her get up to some mischief.[/i][list][*]Triple Take [SECONDARY][list][*]Cooldown :: 10s → 11s[/list][/list][h3][b]Juliette[/b][/h3][i]Juliette trained to be the best, but has been behind the pack for a while. Juliette ult is a cool scoring tool. It also does a lot of damage, so this is just a cautious approach.[/i][list][*]Flame Flurry [SPECIAL][list][*]Cooldown :: 35s → 30s[/list][/list][h3][b]Juno[/b][/h3][i]Some of Juno’s most important awakenings are leaving this patch, but her primary is one of the strongest buttons in the game, especially with the readdtion of hotshot. A small lovetap should make sure she isn't overwhelming.[/i][list][*]Friend Fling [PRIMARY][list][*]Cooldown :: 7s → 7.5s[/list][/list][h3][b]Kazan[/b][/h3][i]Trying not to get carried away, but Kazan was one of the worst performing brawlers. A little nudge up on a less hard to balance button.[/i][list][*]Carried Away [OPEN SECONDARY][list][*]Cooldown :: 16s → 15s[/list][/list][h3][b]Luna[/b][/h3][i]Luna can kill you from across the continent. We like her damage, but she was getting a little too quirked up with inventing some crazy kill confirms. [/i][list][*]W.H.A.M.M.Y. [PRIMARY][list][*]PVP Knockback :: 220 → 200[/list][*]B.O.O.S.T.[list][*]PVP Knockback :: 200 → 165[/list][/list][h3][b]Mako[/b][/h3][i]Mako has an insane tempo. She has probably the best secondary in the game so the cooldown should match. She'll also be easier to hit when she has multiple dash awakenings, as well as being less overwhelming when you can't stop the beat.[/i][list][*]Drum and Base [SECONDARY][list][*]Cooldown :: 18s → 21s[*]Self Slow :: 52.5% → 70%[*]Max hold duration :: 4s → 3.5s[/list][/list][h3][b]Nao[/b][/h3][i]Nao has historically been strong at high levels of play but underperforms at lower levels. This is an experimental change aimed at making her less oppressive with a shot at making it easier to balance her at all levels. [/i][list][*]Sentry Drone [PRIMARY][list][*]Precast channel time :: 0s → 0.2s[/list][*]Proximity Drone [SECONDARY][list][*]Haste :: 50% → 30%[/list][/list][h3][b]Octavia[/b][/h3][i]Evading Octavia primary should be a great counterplay to keeping her flow state up. We wanna keep you in the flow but reduce her potential to keep you boomed.[/i][list][*]Sonic Boom [PRIMARY][list][*]Cooldown :: 7.5s → 10s[/list][/list][h3][b]Rasmus[/b][/h3][i]As captivating as his plays are, Rasmus is doing just a little too much damage while twirling his hook around. These changes are geared towards lowering his ability to KO without any damage awakenings. This change, like Nao and Era, is somewhat experimental as well so I will be monitoring it![/i][list][*]Pendulum Swing [PRIMARY][list][*]Damage / Knockback :: 185 → 165[/list][*]Whiplash [SECONDARY][list][*]Damage / Knockback :: 160 → 120[/list][*]Death Touch [SPECIAL][list][*]Projectile to Creation change time ratio :: .085 → 0.95[*]Deceleration per second :: 4.5 → 4.75[list][*](This means it will become a creation a little bit later after being thrown compared to before)[/list][/list][/list][h3][b]Rune[/b][/h3][i]BANISH! but now 6 seconds less often! Rune is pretty good, but his main abilities are in a good place. This should help hit some of the less interactive interactions Rune enables (looking at you Vyce and Luna).[/i][list][*]Banish [SPECIAL][list][*]Cooldown :: 34s → 40s[/list][/list][h3][b]Vyce[/b][/h3][i]Vyce goalie? Pretty bad. Vyce midfield? Pretty solid. We’re interested to see where she lands after the awakening rotation, but we wanted to give more playmaking opportunities to the heavy metal Oni. We also had some AC/DC fans on the team.[/i][list][*]Thunderstruck [SECONDARY][list][*]Cooldown :: 13s → 11.5s[/list][*]Super Nova [SPECIAL][list][*]Knockback / Damage 160 → 155[/list][/list][h3][b]X[/b][/h3][i]X went a bit eXcessive on the energy drinks and had to take a break from the gym. This works out for us since he was looking to be a bit too strong (don’t tell him we said that). We also told him to hold back a little in the late game due to outrage from the media (have you seen what he did to that Dubu?!?!)[/i][list][*]Base Stats[list][*]Power :: 120 → 115[/list][*]Bull Rush [SECONDARY][list][*]Power scaling :: 95% → 85%[/list][/list]
[h1][b]AWAKENINGS[/b][/h1][i]Our goal to shake up the meta remains true here, but we also had a sub-quest. Down with the almighty Cooldown Reduction! Like speed a few patches ago, cooldown reduction has remained a domineering stat and can feel extremely oppressive to play against. HOWEVER, I also recognize that spamming your skills all the time is simply FUN AS HELL. The power fantasy of “lots of buttons” shouldn’t disappear but players should have to be just a little bit more mindful about using a skill.[/i][list][*]Rotated out:[list][*]Spark of Resilience[*]Stagger Swagger[*]Reverberation[*]Rapid Fire[*]Siege Machine[/list][*]Rotated in:[list][*]Spark of Leadership [Nerfed][*]Reptile Remedy [Nerfed][*]Bulk Up[*]Team Player [Nerfed][*]Hotshot [Nerfed][/list][/list][h3][b]Big Fish[/b][/h3][i]Size and winning continues to be a bit too dynamic of a duo. Toning this down also matches the other size awakenings, so we’re hitting two birds with one fish.[/i][list][*]Gain 27.5% → [b]22.5%[/b] Size and 175 max Stagger.[/list][h3][b]Deadeye[/b][/h3][i]Not too long ago the “eye” requirement was reduced and Deadeye became a little too strong. We’re now reducing the “dead” part a bit to match.[/i][list][*]Hit 32.5% → [b]25%[/b] harder (6.5% to Core) against enemies at 525+ range.[/list][h3][b]Explosive Entrance[/b][/h3][i]Easily the weakest of the dash awakenings, we’re trying to help Explosive Entrance out a little bit. Something something more explosive idk[/i][list][*]DASH range, BLINK range, and HASTE effects increased 70%. Your IMPACT abilities hit 13% → [b]15% [/b]harder (3.25% on Core).[/list][h3][b]Fight or Flight[/b][/h3][i]FoF was just a little bit too oppresive to play against in most situations. So it’s getting toned down.[/i][list][*]Gain 15% → [b]12.5%[/b] Speed for 1.25s whenever you hit something or get hit. Refresh your SECONDARY ability whenever you stagger an enemy or become staggered.[/list][h3][b]Heavy Impact[/b][/h3][i]The impacy of Heavy Impact was a bit too heavy. So we made it lighter! Also reduced CDR on the ability. If you are not really sure why, that’s because you didn’t read the top part so go back and read that.[/i][list][*]IMPACT abilities hit 20% →[b] 15%[/b] harder (4% on Core). Whenever you hit 2 or more targets with a single ability, its cooldown is reduced by 30% →[b] 22.5%[/b] (up to 3s → [b]2.25s[/b]).[/list][h3][b]Hotshot[/b][/h3][i]“Ow ow ow ow” - das me touchin hotshot cause it was so hot.[/i][list][*]Striker abilities hit the Core 13% → [b]10%[/b] harder and refund 32.5% → [b]25%[/b] of the ability's cooldown (once per cast, max 3.25s → [b]2.5s[/b])[/list][h3][b]Might of the Colossus[/b][/h3][i]POV: I’m a midfielder and have the first pick. The enemy X has two size awakenings and I see Might of the Colossus. Guess I have to pick this to deny X from going insaneo mode. Denying this awakening sucks, but it’s the main one to deny from size builds. We’re increasing the size marginally to make it feel slightly better.[/i][list][*]Gain 12.5% → [b]15%[/b] Size and 0.60 Power per 1% bonus Size.[/list][h3][b]One-Two Punch[/b][/h3][i]This should allow for a bit more counterplay without taking away any of that precious damage that we know and love. [/i][list][*]Hit 23% harder (12% to Core) against targets you've hit within 2s → [b]1.5s[/b].[/list][h3][b]Reptile Remedy[/b][/h3][i]Not a very “exciting” awakening, but Reptile Remedy had it’s place among the more potent awakenings. This should bring it down a tiny little bit. [/i][list][*]Gain 400 Stagger and heal 5% → [b]4%[/b] missing Stagger per second for 4 seconds whenever you strike the core.[/list][h3][b]Spark of Focus[/b][/h3][i]HOLD UP IS THAT CDR IN MY GOOD CHRISTIAN ANTI-CDR PATCH?[/i][list][*]Gain 4 → [b]5 [/b]Cooldown Rate, plus 12 → [b]9[/b] per SPARK you have.[/list][h3][b]Spark of Leadership[/b][/h3][i]A historically divisive training, Spark of Leadership is back! Yay! Except it’s replacing another spark so it doesn’t hit that overbearing “Exodia” feel, despite being buffed itself. [/i][list][*]SPARK - Your Allies gain 30% -> [b]25%[/b] of your SPARK effects. Gain 4 → [b]6[/b] Cooldown Rate, 120 → [b]130[/b] Stagger, 6 → [b]8[/b] Power, and 1% → [b]2%[/b] Speed.[/list][h3][b]Specialized Training[/b][/h3][i]Are you a midfielder? Have you been removed from the map with eXcessive force recently? If yes, then this one’s for you! [/i][list][*]SPECIAL hits 40% → [b]35%[/b] harder (8% to Core) and heals 40% → [b]35%[/b] more.[/list][h3][b]Stacks on Stacks[/b][/h3][i]A lot of us love going fast, me included, so we’re not removing that top speed. We’re just toning down the acceleration a little bit.[/i][list][*]Hits grant 5 → [b]4[/b] stacks of Speed (0.07% per stack, 10.5% Speed at Max Stacks, 2 stacks for LIGHT hits). At 150 stacks, double the Speed per stack (21% Speed). Stacks reset when K.O.'d and between sets.[/list][h3][b]Stinger[/b][/h3][i]IS THAT…. A STINGER BUFF?? SOUND THE ALARMS! Anyways yeah we buffed Stinger. It has been really bad for a while. In EVERY tier.[/i][list][*]Normal hits deal bonus damage equal to 9% → [b]11%[/b] (Light hits 3%) of enemies' max Stagger over 4s → [b]3.5s.[/b][/list][h3][b]Team Player[/b][/h3][i]I am a longtime Team Player enjoyer but I will be the first to acknowledge that it can be a little annoying to try to counter, especially when stuff gets movin real fast.[/i][list][*]Strikes hit the core 20% → [b]15%[/b] harder when aiming towards an ally. If that Ally strikes the core within 1.5 second(s) they will hit the core 22.5% →[b] 12.5%[/b] harder, if they strike towards an Ally they can transfer this buff.[/list][h3][b]Timeless Creator[/b][/h3][i]Timeless Creator doesn’t only increase the duration of Creations, but it also seems to increase the duration of games!!!!!![/i][list][*]CREATIONS gain 70% → [b]60%[/b] duration and 35% size.[/list][h1][b]GEAR[/b][/h1][h3][b]Magnetized Soles[/b][/h3][i]Mag Soles is still pretty good in every situation. Some slight tuning should get it closer to evening out the power level with Slicks.[/i][list][*]Crossing Midfield grants 21% → [b]20%[/b] Speed for 1.25s.[/list][h3][b]Momentum Boots[/b][/h3][i]Momentum Boots has been bad for a while and goalies are role swapping in droves. Come back goalies! Look, a gift! We promise you don’t have to keep going strike shot![/i][list][*]Gain 5% Speed plus up to 10% → [b]15%[/b] over 8s → [b]12s[/b] (1.25% Movement Speed per Stack). Getting hit resets the added effect.[/list]

notes.title: Omega Strikers - April 17th Micropatch | Update Notes
notes.notes:
[h2]Bonjour, Strikers![/h2]
Welcome to another edition of the Omega Strikers Micropatch Patch Notes ft. Aesop (That’s me) (I’m Aesop)
Nothing crazy this patch as it is just a micropatch to shake up some balance and meta stuff.
I didn’t change Zentaro’s special CD again. Yet.
I did buff Orb Replicator though and it’s gonna be good one day you’ll see!

Today’s patch was also thought up in part with my secret random patch consortium, ft. HamsterQuest, Mexicasual, MookMook, VeryGeneric, and Trajiic.With that all being said, LET’S BEGIN
[hr][/hr]
[h1][b]STRIKERS[/b][/h1][h3]Asher[/h3][i]Aside from a small adjustment to her Primary recently, Asher has been pretty much untouched for months and has slowly crept upwards in her efficiency. [/i][list][*]Base Stats[list][*]Power: 120→ 115[/list][*]Barrier Beam [PRIMARY][list][*]Cooldown :: 9s → 10s[/list][*]Breakthrough [SECONDARY][list][*]Cooldown :: 16s → 14.5s[/list][/list][h3]Atlas[/h3][i]Atlas is still feasting with the beasts and is pretty much outperforming all the other goalies.[/i][list][*]Astral Projection [PRIMARY][list][*]Damage/Knockback :: 180 + 90% → 180 + 80%[*]Core Knockback :: 1340 + 180% → 1330 + 175%[/list][/list][h3]Drek’ar[/h3][i]Trying an experimental change on Drek to make his primary fire off a little quicker.[/i][list][*]Lock and Load [PRIMARY][list][*]Pre-Channel time :: .35s → .28s[/list][/list][h3]Dubu[/h3][list][*]Rollout[PRIMARY][list][*]Knockback / Damage :: 170 + 85% -> 170 + 78%[/list][*]Somerassault[SECONDARY][list][*]Knockback / Damage :: 230 + 110% -> 230 + 105%[/list][/list][h3]Era[/h3][i]Era is falling behind just a little bit in some tiers, this should just be a little love to people who like to spam her tornados (I’m talking about myself here) [/i][list][*]Magic Maelstrom [SPECIAL][list][*]Cooldown :: 20s → 18.5s[/list][/list][h3]Estelle[/h3][i]Estelle has just been a tiny bit above where she should be following her back to back buffs.[/i][list][*]Crystal Thorns [SPECIAL][list][*]Cooldown :: 22s → 23s[/list][/list][h3]Kai[/h3][i]Little love to Kai following his back to back speed nerfs.[/i][list][*]Blazing Pace [SECONDARY][list][*]Cooldown :: 16s → 15s[/list][*]Giga Blast [SPECIAL][list][*]Damage :: 235 → 220[*]Cooldown :: 23s → 21s[/list][/list][h3]Kazan[/h3][i]Kazan is a tricky character to adjust but we’ll try hitting his Closed Strike a bit and seeing if that makes him less of a menace in places.[/i][list][*]Press the Point [CLOSED form Strike][list][*]Core Knockback :: 1300 + 150% → 1230 + 145%[/list][/list][h3]Mako[/h3][i]Continuing the live surgery of Mako to try to make her not super oppressive in higher tiers while pretty bad elsewhere. [/i][list][*]Perfect Pitch [PRIMARY][list][*]Damage/Knockback :: 20 → 15[/list][*]Drum and Base [SECONDARY][list][*]Haste granted :: 23.5% → 22%[*]Size granted :: 20% → 21%[/list][*]Ensnare Drums [SPECIAL][list][*]Cooldown :: 38s → 36s[/list][/list][h3]Nao[/h3][i]A longtime strong staple in higher tiers of play, Nao needs a little touch to bring her strength down while not totally handicapping her in lower tiers.[/i][list][*]Proximity Drone [SECONDARY][list][*]Cooldown :: 9s → 10.5s[/list][/list][h3]Rasmus[/h3][i]Tiny adjustment to Rasmus to make him DIE A LITTLE MORE DIE DIE DIE.[/i][list][*]Base Stats[list][*]Stagger Scaling :: 375 → 325[/list][/list][h3]Vyce[/h3][i]Experimental change similar to Drek’ar, making Vyce’s projectile a little faster. This also functionally increases the range a touch so I’m monitoring it to make sure it doesn’t go crazy.[/i][list][*]Power Chord [PRIMARY][list][*]Velocity :: 2350 → 2585 (10% faster) [/list][/list]
[h1][b]MAPS AND MODES[/b][/h1][i]I did a poll to decide the new maps and it didn’t fit my narrative so I only picked the top ones that were chosen. Will prolly do weekly map changes starting the Monday after this patch goes out. [/i]

Rotated out:[list][*]Inky's Splash Zone[*]Ai.Mi's App[/list]Rotated In:[list][*]Night Market[*]Demon Dais[/list]
[h1][b]AWAKENINGS[/b][/h1]Rotated out:[list][*]Chronoboost[*]Perfect Form[/list]Rotated In:[list][*]Explosive Entrance[*]Fight or Flight (Nerfed)[/list][h3]Built Different[/h3][i]Hitting size a little bit and BD is just overall always really good. [/i][list][*]Size :: 25% → 22.5%[/list][h3]Fight or Flight[/h3][i]This mf is polarizing. Gonna nerf it a bit and see how it does in the long run.[/i][list][*]Speed: 17.5% → 15%[*]Duration: 1.5s → 1.25s[/list][h3]Might of the Colossus[/h3][i]Another size boy. Except I’m not hitting the Size itself on this one.[/i][list][*]Power per 1% bonus size :: .65 → .60[/list][h3]Orb Replicator[/h3][i]IT’S GONNA BE GOOD.[/i][list][*]Orb benefits shared to allies :: 75% → 110%[/list][h3]One-Two Punch[/h3][i]Overall a pretty good choice in all situations and even better on more brawly maps, just want to bring it down a little touch.[/i][list][*]Hit 26% -> 23% (13 -> 12% core) Harder [/list][h3]Recovery Drone[/h3][i]Another size guy. Honestly what if I actually just remove size from this entirely. Would that be crazy???[/i][list][*]Size:: 25% → 20% [/list][h3]Reverberation[/h3][i]Little more base stagger but lower scaling. Will always be weaker. [/i][list][*]Stagger :: 350 → 360[*]Cooldown per stagger: 1.25 → 1.20[/list]

notes.title: Omega Strikers - March 6th Micropatch | Update Notes
notes.notes:
Alright Strikers, you know what time it is!! It’s PATCH TIME!

Before we get started I’d like to shout out the [url=https://www.makeship.com/products/finii-plushie]Finii Plush[/url] that is now on sale! Get it before it’s too late!

[url=https://www.makeship.com/products/finii-plushie][img]https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0125/8261/7145/files/Finii_Plushie-SV4-P-1_1000x.png.webp?v=1739981726[/img][/url]

Okay. Anyway!

Couple interesting balance changes today in this patch - new base speed tiers for strikers as forwards/midfield/goalies and stuff like that. I’m also working on a couple small tiny baby reworks to some awakenings if it’s possible for the future. I don’t even know if it actually [i]is[/i] possible but hey you never know!

Also, shouts out to the 4 players who were randomly selected to help put this patch together!! They are[b] Goomy, FudgyWaffles, SwiftDeity,[/b] and [b]Hekuria/MrWolf[/b].
Shouts out to them.

Alright let’s get started!

[hr][/hr]

[h1][b]STRIKERS[/b][/h1][h3]Atlas[/h3][i]While you were out eating shrimp with the wimps, Atlas was feasting with the beasts in the goal arc. Small change to his primary and base speed should satiate his appetite. [/i][list][*]Base Stats[list][*]Speed : 440 → 435[/list][*]Astral Projection [PRIMARY][list][*]Cooldown :: 8.5s → 9s[/list][/list][h3]Drek’ar[/h3][i]Lower on the pick rate of tiers and only pretty good with a small subset of people, Drek could use a little lizard love.[/i][list][*]Xeno Cloak [SECONDARY][list][*]Cooldown :: 12s → 11s[/list][/list][h3]Estelle[/h3][i]Speed tier adjustment[/i][list][*]Base Stats [list][*]Speed :: 445→ 450[/list][/list][h3]Finii[/h3][i]Finii is just kinda weak in pretty much every tier. Plus she’s getting a plush so I have to give her a faux mascot buff, right?[/i][list][*]Base Stats[list][*]Speed :: 465 → 460[/list][*]Triple Take [SECONDARY][list][*]Damage Taken By Enemies buff :: 20 → 25%[/list][/list][h3]Juliette[/h3][i]Speed tier adjustment[/i][list][*]Base Stats [list][*]Speed :: 460 → 450[/list][/list][h3]Juno[/h3][i]Jumping around all over the place and smashing red cores instantly in OT made Juno a little annoying to play against. This should tune her down a touch.[/i][list][*]Base Stats[list][*]Speed :: 460 → 455[*]Stagger Growth :: 450 → 375[/list][/list][h3]Kai[/h3][i]Speed tier adjustment[/i][list][*]Base Stats [list][*]Speed :: 465 → 460[/list][/list][h3]Kazan[/h3][i]There’s a small slice of players that are really good with Kazan, but outside of that, he’s like really bad elsewhere. This change should affect those good players less than the rest.[/i][list][*]Base Stats[list][*]Speed :: 440 → 445[*]Power :: 90 → 95[/list][/list][h3]Luna[/h3][i]Speed tier adjustment[/i][list][*]Base Stats [list][*]Speed :: 460 → 455[/list][/list][h3]Mako[/h3][i]Mako is a really good goalie in a lot of tiers, a weak forward everywhere. Tuning down her damage a touch to stop those across map million damage shots. She’s on my radar for a small rework if possible, but we’ll see how that goes. [/i][list][*]Perfect Pitch [PRIMARY][list][*]Projectile Damage / Knockback :: 105 + 52.5% ⇾ 103 + 51.5% power[/list][/list][h3]Octavia[/h3][i]Speed tier adjustment[/i][list][*]Base Stats [list][*]Speed :: 475 → 465[/list][/list][h3]Rasmus[/h3][i]He was in a mostly good place but could just use a little bit of love.[/i][list][*]Whiplash [SECONDARY][list][*]Duration :: 2.25s → 2.5s [/list][/list][h3]Rune[/h3][i]Speed tier adjustment[/i][list][*]Base Stats [list][*]Speed :: 465→ 450[/list][/list][h3]Vyce[/h3][i]Small tweak to Vyce. Her “damage” tool is doing less than her “movement” tool. [/i][list][*]Power Chord [PRIMARY][list][*]Damage / Knockback :: 175 + 87.5%  → 180 + 90%[/list][*]Thunderstruck [SECONDARY][list][*]Cooldown :: 12s → 13s[/list][/list][h3]X[/h3][i]Tiniest adjustment of all time to keep X from going too insane with new speeds.[/i][list][*]Base Stats[list][*]Power :: 125 → 120[/list][/list][h3]Zentaro[/h3][i]The standard is the standard.[/i][list][*]Base Stats[list][*]Speed :: 460 → 450[/list][*]Oni’s Blade [SPECIAL][list][*]Cooldown :: 40s → 35s[/list][/list]
[h1][b]MAPS AND MODES[/b][/h1][i]I’m considering making map rotation a weekly thing, i.e. changing 1 map each week. Lmk if you like this idea.[/i]

[b]Rotated In:[/b] Oni Village, Clarion Corp
[b]Rotated Out:[/b] Taiko Temple, Night Market

notes.title: Omega Strikers - Season 5 Update | January 13th Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello there my loyal Omega Strikers community!
Today we are happy to bring you the SEASON 5 PATCH!!! Yipee!
You know the drill by now - new season means new stuff: new battlepass levels, new balance changes, and a NEW SKIN REWARD for reaching Gold! Any guesses as to who it might be? (Hint, just scroll down the answer is in there.)

With all that being said, let us get into the dirty deets of this here patch I tell you what. 

[hr][/hr]

[h1][b]SEASON RESET[/b][/h1][i]NEW SEASON! With Season 5, we’re resetting the ranks a bit (the same as last time). I’m also working on a way to try and get you to view your historical stats so you can look back on your past and reminisce on how you went crazy as Asher last season.

[/i][b]Ranked Rewards:[/b][list][*]Aqua Cannon goal explosion[list][*](This isn't a seasonal reward btw, this is a forever thing that you'll unlock once you hit challenger any time in the future.)[/list][*]Top "x" titles[list][*]ex: Top 5, Top 10, Top 25, etc[/list][*]Mako Recolor [list][*]“Sakura Mako”[*]For anyone who reaches Gold![/list][*]An emote for reaching Platinum[*]An emote for playing a bunch of games[list][*]25 Ranked Games to be exact [/list][*]New Battlepass Levels[list][*]Also please note that after a certain Battlepass level, you can no longer purchase additional levels with Ody points. [/list][/list]Most rewards will be based on your Season *Peak* rating, but the titles for "Top X%" will be based on your leaderboard position at the end of the season.
As always, you can track your progress and match history at our official site at https://stats.omegastrikers.gg/ [h1][b]MAP ROTATION[/b][/h1][i]I vow to never have Knife’s Edge and Ai.Mi’s app playable at the same time. Also shut up about Inky’s. I like that map and I’M THE BOSS.[/i]

[b]Rotated Out[/b][list][*]Demon Dais[*]Ahten City[/list][b]Rotated In[/b][list][*]Inky’s Splash Zone[*]Ai.Mi’s App[/list][h1][b]STRIKERS[/b][/h1][i]I’m going to be toning down Speed on a lot of things. It’s a very strong stat and has been steadily increased over the lifetime, resulting in like some “speed creep”. My hands can’t keep up anymore please help. [/i][h3][b]Asher[/b][/h3][i]She’s just been a little weak so Asher just gets a little buff.[/i][list][*]Barrier Beam [PRIMARY][list][*]Cooldown :: 9.5s → 9s[/list][/list][h3][b]Ai.Mi[/b][/h3][i]A nearly must-pick/ban Striker in high elos, Ai.Mi has been going kinda crazy everywhere else as well.[/i][list][*]Cyber Swipe [SECONDARY][list][*]Dash Range :: 600 → 550[*]Damage / Knockback :: 185 + 92.5 → 190 + 90%[/list][/list][h3][b]Era[/b][/h3][i]Era kinda fell to the wayside in all tiers. She’s not unreasonably weak but could use some love.[/i][list][*]Bewitching Beam [PRIMARY][list][*]Ally Power granted :: 70 → 75[*]Ally Size granted :: 50 → 35[*]Enemy Power Debuff :: 70% → 75%[*]Enemy Speed Debuff :: 20% → 25%[/list][*]Flutter Fly [SECONDARY][list][*]Cooldown :: 18s → 16s [*]Speed Boost:: 60% → 52.5%[/list][/list][h3][b]Estelle[/b][/h3][i]Kind of a sub-par midfielder and a sub-par goalie, Estelle gets a little tiny bit of love to bring her closer to her buddies.[/i][list][*]Piercing Shot [PRIMARY][list][*]Cooldown :: 10s → 9s[/list][/list][h3][b]Juliette[/b][/h3][i]Jules is preforming pretty well in all tiers, even after a nerf last patch. Just want to tone her down a little tiny bit more.[/i][list][*]Fiery Fist [PRIMARY][list][*]Damage / Knockback :: 145 + 72.5% → 145 + 72%[/list][*]Flying Phoenix [SECONDARY][list][*]Damage / Knockback :: 160 + 80% → 150 + 80% [/list][/list][h3][b]Kai[/b][/h3][i]Lowering Kai’s base speed but giving him a little more juice on his speed boost so he’s not flying around always and is instead only flying around sometimes.  [/i][list][*]Base Stats[list][*]Speed :: 475 → 465[/list][*]Blazing Pace [SECONDARY][list][*]Buff Duration :: 4s → 4.5s[/list][/list][h3][b]Rune[/b][/h3][i]I buffed Rune last patch and he went slightly overboard. Hehe my bad.[/i][list][*]Banish [SPECIAL][list][*]Damage / Knockback :: 270 + 135% → 270 + 130%[/list][/list][h3][b]Vyce[/b][/h3][i]Vyce is pretty near the bottom of performance in all tiers of play (but near the top in amount of people yapping about her being OP). [/i][list][*]Thunderstruck [SECONDARY][list][*]Cooldown :: 12s → 11s[*]Damage and Knockback :: 200 (+100%) → 200(+90%)[/list][*]Powerchord [PRIMARY][list][*]Enemy Speed Debuff :: 1s → 1.1s[/list][/list][h1][b]AWAKENINGS[/b][/h1][i]We’re kinda cooking with awakening rotation. I’ll keep an eye on it if anything gets too crazy too quickly.[/i][list][*]Rotated out:[list][*]Chronoboost[*]Egoist[*]Knife's Edge [*]Prize Fighter[*]Team Player[*]Unstoppable[/list][*]Rotated in: [list][*]Among Titans[*]Glass Cannon [Retuned][*]Heavy Impact[*]Might of the Colossus [Nerfed][*]Siege Machine [Buffed][*]Specialized Training[/list][/list][h3]Aerials[/h3][i]Moving some of the dash power to projectiles.[/i][list][*]Dash/Blink/Haste Increase :: 80% → 75%[*]Projectile Range Increase  :: 40% → 42.5%[/list][h3]Cast to Last[/h3][i]CTL is the pretty much the worst performing in its class.[/i][list][*]Buff and Debuff duration :: 50% → 55%[/list][h3]Demolitionist[/h3][i]There’s a lot of size stuff goin' on this patch. Let’s not have it be overwhelming. Hopefully.[/i][list][*]Size Gain :: 25% → 20%[/list][h3]Glass Cannon[/h3][i]Ramps up and gets you to max stacks faster, but max is a little weaker.[/i][list][*]Gain 5 → 4 Power and 3% → 2% Speed every 2s (up to 28 Power and 14% Speed).[/list][h3]Magnetized Soles[/h3][i]A clear front-runner among Gear, Mag Soles is taking some heat with the speed changes.[/i][list][*]Midfield Speed Boost :: 23% → 22%[/list][h3]Might of the Colossus[/h3][i]There’s a lot of size stuff goin on this patch. Let’s not have it be overwhelming. Hopefully. Yeah I copied and pasted this. Sue me.[/i][list][*]Size :: 15% → 12.5%[/list][h3]Missile Propulsion[/h3][i]This one goes out to all the people who get hit by every random Luna missile. (Me)[/i][list][*]Damage buff :: 20% harder (4% to Core) → 22.5% harder (4.5% to core)[/list][h3]Primetime[/h3][i]Without Rapid Fire, Primetime isn’t really that great.[/i][list][*]Hit power reduction :: 5% → 4.5% (Core damage unchanged)[/list][h3]Siege Machine[/h3][i]Siege Machine had a 0% win rate since last patch. [/i][list][*]Creations :: Hit 15% → 20% harder (3% → 4% to Core).[/list][h3]Spark of Resilience[/h3][i]Clearly the worst performing spark when on its own or not paired with all the other sparks.[/i][list][*]Base Max Stagger :: 100 → 105[/list][h3]Stagger Swagger[/h3][list][*]Base Speed boost :: 7.5% → 7%[/list][h3]Stacks on Stacks[/h3][list][*]Speed per Stack :: 0.075% → 0.070% (10.5% Speed at Max Stacks)[/list]

notes.title: Omega Strikers - December 5th Update | Ahten Winter Festival!
notes.notes:
HELLO Strikers.

We’ve got a big one today, full of SURPRISES for you all. What surprises, you may ask? 

[h2][b]NEW STUFF![/b][/h2]

A key part of this update is an exciting feature that we know you’ve been asking about for a while…

We’ve finally added voice chat to Omega Strikers, and, even better, we've partnered up with Discord to give you seamless, reliable communication features directly within the game.

It’s super simple to do, all you need is to link your Discord account to Omega Strikers and you’ll be able to happily chat away with your Goalie when they miss a save! You won’t be mean! Surely!

It’ll also import your Discord friends right to OS so you don’t have to worry about searching them up and finding them - as long as they have their Discord accounts linked.

We’ll also have it so you can chat with your buds in-game via Discord so it syncs with your account. Never miss a message again when your friend tells you to hop on!

Don’t have a Discord account? That’s chill too - you can still join voice calls and everything in-game. You’ll just be missing out on the automatic friend syncing and Discord message syncing.

[i]Please note that this feature will only be available on the PC version of Omega Strikers at this time![/i]


We've also got new skins for your favorite characters, balance changes, new emotes (and 2 more emote slots actually), and NEW SKINS BRO FOR REAL.
Alright, let’s check out the details, shall we?
[hr][/hr]
[h1][b]SYSTEMS[/b][/h1][list][*]Discord Integration[list][*]Full in-game voice chat with teammates[list][*]No Discord account is required to chat, but you’ll miss out on the extra features![/list][*]Your Discord friends list in-game.[*]Quick adds to your Discord friends so you don’t have to search to find them.[*]Message syncing with across OS and Discord.[*]Easy account linking via OS settings.[*]Note: will only be available on the PC version of Omega Strikers at this time[/list]

Just gonna tone him down a tiny little bit. [/i][list][*]Somerassault [SECONDARY][list][*]Cooldown :: 17s → 18s[*]Damage :: 220 → 230[/list][/list][h3]Juliette[/h3][i]HUGE nerf. notes.title: Omega Strikers - October 7th Micropatch | Update Notes
notes.notes:
BONJOUR Strikers. 
We’re serving you up the fattest micropatch of the day today, it’s pretty low carb and features things like BUFFS and NERFS and stuff like that. You know how it is.
We’ve actually got a tiny little surprise for you cookin' in our proverbial oven so keep your eyes peeled for that as we wrap things up there!!
Alright then for now, let’s just jump into this micropatch. 

[hr][/hr]
[h1][b]STRIKERS[/b][/h1][h3]Asher [/h3][i]Asher is not only the queen of a lot of your hearts, she’s also been the queen of the field. We’re toning her down as both goalie and forward to keep her in line. Don’t worry tho, she’s still plenty toned.[/i][list][*]Base Stats[list][*]Power: 125 → 120[/list][*]Breakthrough [SECONDARY][list][*]Cooldown :: 15s → 16s[/list][*]Barrier Beam [PRIMARY][list][*]Cooldown :: 9s → 9.5s[/list][/list][h3]Drek’ar[/h3][i]It’s getting close to winter so Drek needs to warm up a bit. (He’s a cold blooded kil - erm - lizard). [/i][list][*]Molten Bolt [SPECIAL][list][*]DOT Damage :: 18(+9% Power) →20(+10% Power) [list][*](Full duration burn damage :: 265.5 → 295)[/list][/list][/list][h3]Estelle [/h3][i]Her speed was tuned down last patch. She landed a little weaker than we liked so we tuned up her power a bit elsewhere. (What is she like a muscle car? wtf) [/i][list][*]Crystal Thorns [SPECIAL][list][*]Damage & Knockback :: 120 (+60% Power) → 130 (+65% Power)[*]Core Knockback :: 1220 (+120% Power) → 1240 (+130% Power)[/list][*]Piercing Shot [PRIMARY][list][*]Damange & Knockback :: 180 (+90% Power) → 185 (+92.5% Power)[*]Core Knockback :: 1340 (+180% Power) → 1350 (+185% Power)[/list][/list][h3]Octavia[/h3][i]Last patch hit her a little harder than we intended so we’re splitting the difference and giving her a little gift of stagger for good measure. It’s ain’t OCTober without and OCTavia buff lol. Octavia Omega Strikers. October.[/i][list][*]Base Stats[list][*]Stagger Growth :: 125 → 200[/list][*]Flow State [SECONDARY][list][*]Base Speed:: 20% → 24% [*]Speed per second :: 2% → 1.8%[/list][/list][h3]Rasmus[/h3][i]We buffed Rasmus recently but now it’s time for the pendulum to swing the other way. [previewyoutube=jMz0jxxT2Xw;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Omega Strikers - August 29th Update | Season 4!!
notes.notes:
HEY STRIKING STRIKERS
We really out here with a new patch for SEASON 4 OMEGA STRIKERS!!!
Naturally, we don’t have a [i]ton[/i] of new stuff while the team cooks up some new prototypes (and this is technically a micropatch anyway) but we still want to bring you some nifty new changes.
Among those nifty changes are character adjustments and a NEW SKIN REWARD for you climbers.

We also got a couple more small features headed your way in a bigger patch, so keep an eye out for that!

[hr][/hr]
[h1][b]SEASON RESET[/b][/h1][i]NEW SEASON!!! LET’S GOOOOO. START THE CLIMB!! The reset algorithm backend has been improved pretty nicely and we fixed some niche bugs where people were unintentionally losing progress or getting wrong gains. Sick.[/i]Ranked Rewards:[list][*]Aqua Cannon goal explosion[list][*](This isn't a seasonal reward btw, this is a forever thing that you'll unlock once you hit challenger any time in the future.)[/list][*]Top "x" titles[list][*]ex: Top 5, Top 10, Top 25, etc[/list][*]Nao Recolor [list][*]For anyone who reaches Gold![/list][*]An emote for reaching plat[*]An emote for playing a bunch of games[list][*]25 Ranked Games to be exact [/list][/list]Most rewards will be based on your Season *Peak* rating, but the titles for "Top X%" will be based on your leaderboard position at the end of the season.As always, you can track your progress and match history at our site at https://stats.omegastrikers.gg/ [h1][b]MAP ROTATION[/b][/h1][i]Btw there’s 1 fewer map in the rotation now.[/i][b]Rotated Out[/b][list][*]Night Market[*]Gates of Obscura[*]Ahten City[/list][b]Rotated In[/b][list][*]Atlas's Lab[*]Taiko Temple[/list][h1][b]STRIKERS[/b][/h1][h3][b]Ai.Mi[/b][/h3][i]Nerf so small you can call this kitten sized.[/i][list][*]Cyber Swipe [SECONDARY][list][*]Damage and Knockback :: 195 (+97.5) → 185 (+92.5%)[*]Secondary Core Knockback :: 1300(+185%) → 1280(+175%)[/list][/list][h3][b]Atlas[/b][/h3][list][*]Celestial Intervention [SPECIAL][list][*]BUGFIX: Revives should now work properly. Should no longer fail to revive in some instances.[/list][/list][h3][b]Drek’ar[/b][/h3][i]After his recent buffs, lizard has been uhhh… been burning up players at high elo and now he’s gonna do it less.[/i][list][*]Molten Bolt [SPECIAL][list][*]Cooldown :: 30s → 35s[/list][/list][h3][b]Finii[/b][/h3][i]FINII GOALIE IS NUTS. FINII SHOW CANCELLED A LITTLE.[/i][list][*]Base Stats[list][*]Speed :: 475 → 465[/list][*]Triple Take [SECONDARY][list][*]Cooldown :: 8s → 10s[/list][/list][h3][b]Juliette[/b][/h3][i]10 speed is pretty big okay. Juliette strong now since she was falling off in the meta.[/i][list][*]Base Stats[list][*]Speed :: 450 → 460[/list][/list][h3][b]Juno[/b][/h3][i]10 speed AND 5 power is even BIGGER than just 10 speed. Juno mains rejoice.[/i][list][*]Base Stats[list][*]Power :: 90→ 95[*]Speed :: 450 → 460[/list][/list][h3][b]Kazan[/b][/h3][i]Kazan goalie has been sleeper OP. We’re hitting these stats in particular to lower his prowess in net.[/i][list][*]Base Stats[list][*]Speed :: 450 → 440[/list][*]Crooked Leverage [PRIMARY - CLOSED][list][*]Cooldown :: 9.5s → 10s[/list][/list][h3][b]Mako[/b][/h3][i]Struggling to keep the tempo after the instant-cast removal, so we’re loading more power into her secondary to make up for what she lost. [/i][list][*]Drum and Base [SECONDARY][list][*]No longer tagged as MELEE[list][*]Functionality unchanged[/list][*]Self slow :: 47% → 43% (Base speed while casting :: 289 → 314)[*]Cooldown :: 20s → 18s[/list][/list][h3][b]Nao[/b][/h3][i]Since launch, Nao’s strength has been divided among two groups: really powerful in coordinated play, but pretty weak in solo queue in not high tiers of play. We’ve adjusted a lot of stuff in her kit previously, but she’s still not really where we want her to be for either group. We’re shaking her kit up by removing the hit stun and some PVP power from her secondary to make it a more reliable tool and adding some extra strength to her primary. We’ll be keeping an eye on this and will follow up if needed.[/i][list][*]Proximity Drone [SECONDARY][list][*]Hit type :: Normal → Light[*]Cooldown ::12s → 9s[*]Arm time :: 0.25s → 0.15s  [/list][*]Sentry Drone [PRIMARY][list][*]Max Duration :: 3.5s → 4s (Max hit power still occurs after 2s)[/list][/list][h3][b]Octavia[/b][/h3][i]We’ve activated additional speed awakenings this patch so we’re making sure Octy doesn’t go crazy with those.[/i][list][*]Flow State [SECONDARY][list][*]Base speed :: 28 → 20[*]Speed per second :: 1.6 → 2 [/list][/list][h3][b]Rasmus[/b][/h3][i]Little boost aimed at higher-tier play.[/i][list][*]Whiplash [SECONDARY][list][*]Damage and Knockback :: 150 (+70%) → 160 (+80%)[*]Core Knockback :: 1280 (+150%) → 1300 (+160%)[/list][/list][h3][b]Rune[/b][/h3][i]5 speed and 10 power? That’s the Juno change but reversed!!![/i][list][*]Base Stats[list][*]Speed :: 160 → 165[*]Power :: 100 → 110[/list][/list][h3][b]Vyce[/b][/h3][i]Last set of nerfs dampened her sound, man. We’re giving her some more reliable cooldowns, but still making sure she doesn’t drown out the rest of the cast.[/i][list][*]Thunderstruck [SECONDARY][list][*]Cooldown :: 14s → 12s[*]Damage and Knockback :: 220 (+110%) → 200 (+100%)[/list][/list][h3][b]X[/b][/h3][i]He lost 5 power! Where did that go? To Juno? X was just kinda good last patch so we’re turning him down a bit. [/i][list][*]Base Stats[list][*]Power :: 130 → 125[/list][*]X Maximus! [SPECIAL][list][*]Cooldown :: 35s → 37.5s[/list][/list][h1][b]AWAKENINGS[/b][/h1][list][*]Rotated out:[list][*]Heavy impact[*]Bulk Up[*]Stinger[*]Reptile Remedy[*]Quick Strikes[*]Peak Performance[/list][*]Rotated in: [list][*]Stagger Swagger [Retuned][*]Built Different[*]Timeless Creator[*]Egoist [Retuned][*]Fight or Flight [*]Super Surge [/list][/list][h3]Deadeye[/h3][list][*]Range required to activate :: 550 → 525[/list][h3]Egoist[/h3][list][*]Burst of speed when hitting max energy :: 80% → 60%[*]Speed boost duration :: 8s → 6s[*] Persistent Speed boost at max energy:: 12%→8%[/list][h3]Momentum Boots[/h3][list][*]Speed boost at max stacks :: 20% → 15%[/list][h3]Stagger Swagger[/h3][list][*]Base Speed boost :: 10% → 7.5%[*]Speed boost while staggered :: 20% → 15%[/list][h3]Twin Drive[/h3][list][*]Cooldown :: 2.5% Increase → 2.5% Decrease[/list]

notes.title: Omega Strikers - July 24th Micropatch | Update Notes | Summer Splash Mini

Check the Missions tab and you can unlock yourself some summery emotes and goodies. 
As an added bonus, Summer Splash (Mini) is actually happening in summer this year! So let us begin.

Celestial Intervention also was (is) kinda bugged so this should also help mitigate some of those effects, while also strengthening him.[/i][list][*]Celestial Intervention [SPECIAL][list][*]Healing Per tick :: 3.75% Max stagger → 4% Max Stagger [/list][*]Cosmic Expanse [SECONDARY][list][*]Cooldown :: 21s → 20s[/list][/list][h3]Dubu [/h3][i]Large Goalie Buffs: Part II. [/i]

We're pulling back some of those changes and loading more power into Drum and Base to compensate.[/i][list][*]Drum and Base [SECONDARY][list][*]Minimum cast time :: 0.25s → 0.2s[*]Self-slow while channeling :: 52% → 47%[list][*](Base speed while channeling :: 262 → 289)[/list][*]Size and Haste linger after cast :: 0.5s → 0.75s[/list][*]Perfect Pitch [PRIMARY] [list][*]Minimum cast time :: 0.15s → 0.1s[/list][/list][h3]Rasmus [/h3][i]2 more seconds of worry free gameplay on Ai.Mi’s app. [/i][list][*]Death Touch [SPECIAL][list][*]Cooldown :: 20s → 22s[/list][/list][h3]Vyce [/h3][i]Vyce’s damage was *off the charts[/i]*[i] - especially if she picked up a couple cooldown awakenings. notes.title: Omega Strikers - July 4th Update | Update Notes
notes.notes:
Hello STRIKERS!! Hope your summer is going well!! (Or if you’re in like Australia, hope your winter is going well?)

Today’s update features a couple of quality of life features you’ve been requesting for a while, some new community stuff, and some of your favorite balance adjustments. We even threw in some bugfixes for good measure.

With that, shall we begin fellow strikers?

[hr][/hr]
[h1][b]SYSTEM CHANGES[/b][/h1][h2]Pick Order Display[/h2][list][*]Now displays which team picks first when it’s snake draft![list][*]Located in the top left under the current map name[/list][/list][h2]Pre-Match Mastery Banner Effects[/h2][list][*]You can now show off how good you are at Asher before the match starts.[/list][h2]In-Game Name Change Feature[/h2][list][*]Go to the Settings and change your name![list][*]No cost (Ody/Striker Coins)[*]You can only change it once every 90 days.[list][*]Don’t change it and then be like “actually I don’t like it” and make a ticket, I’ll be so mad.[/list][/list][/list][h2]In-Game HUD Update[/h2][list][*]Just a small update to the change we made a bit ago.[list][*]Increased size and some polish.[/list][/list][h2]Maps and Modes[/h2][h3]Map Rotations[/h3][list][*]Rotated in[list][*]Ai.Mi’s App[*]Oni Village[*]Demon Dais[/list][*]Rotated out [list][*]Taiko Temple[*]Atlas’s Lab[*]Inky’s Splash Zone[/list][/list][h1][b]COSMETICS[/b][/h1][i]Thanks to our incredible community, we got a couple new emoticons, titles, and nameplates! We’ll be making ways to get those over the coming days.[/i][h3]Nameplates[/h3][list][*]New Community Nameplates[/list][h3]Emoticons[/h3][list][*]New Community Emoticons[/list][h3]Titles[/h3][list][*]New community Titles[/list][h1][b]STRIKERS[/b][/h1][i]We’ve got just a couple adjustments to some Strikers. Nothing big like the last batch where we changed virtually everything though![/i][h3][b]Atlas[/b][/h3][i]Atlas has been exploring space and gaining knowledge so you haven’t seen him in a while. He learned how to reduce the cooldown of his Secondary so you might be seeing him more often.[/i][list][*]Cosmic Expanse [SECONDARY][list][*]Cooldown :: 22s → 21s[/list][/list][h3][b]Drek'ar[/b][/h3][i]He’s a little stronger now and upgraded his Xeno Cloak so he can go invisible for longer. In general, we are trying to push some power away from his primary and into his other abilities so that Drek’ar won’t be so much of a one trick lizard.[/i][list][*]Base Stats[list][*]Power :: 90 → 95[/list][*]Xeno Cloak [SECONDARY][list][*]Duration :: 1.0s → 1.25s[*]Speed Boost :: 50% → 40%[*]Stealth hit amp now has a 0.25s post-stealth grace window [/list][/list][h3][b]Estelle[/b][/h3][i]Crystal Volley balls too hard sometimes so we’re turning it down. [/i][list][*]Crystal Volley [SPECIAL][list][*]Cooldown :: 20s → 22s [/list][/list][h3][b]Finii[/b][/h3][i]Finii was struggling to find her rabbit footing so we’re moving some of the power from her supportive utility to her own abilities. We’re also letting her hop across the battlefield a little quicker for good measure.[/i][list][*]Base Stats[list][*]Speed :: 470 → 475 [/list][*]Triple Take [SECONDARY] [list][*]Damage per pulse ::  50(+25% Power) → 55(+27.5% Power)[*]Core Knockback :: 1080 (+50% Power) → 1090(+55% Power)[*]Ally Damage Boost :: 30% → 20%[/list][/list][h3][b]Kai[/b][/h3][i]Sick Giga Blasts from like across the map are now cooler and better. You just can’t try and spam it as frequently.[/i][list][*]Giga Blast [SPECIAL][list][*]PvP Knockback and Damage :: 220 (+110% Power) → 240 (+120% Power)[*]Core Knockback :: 1390 (+205% Power) → 1400 (+210% Power)[*]Cooldown :: 22s → 23s[/list][/list][h3]Juliette[/h3][i]Try Juliette goalie! Surely it’s good![/i][list][*]Flying Phoenix [Secondary][list][*]Cooldown :: 16s → 15s[/list][/list][h3][b]Luna[/b][/h3][i]Luna was pretty good in all tiers, especially in higher skill levels. Fewer random across-map rockets now.[/i][list][*]W.H.A.M.M.Y. [PRIMARY][list][*]Cooldown :: 6.5s → 7.5s[/list][*]Stagger Growth Tier :: 375 → 250[/list][h3][b]Nao[/b][/h3][i]Nao is quite strong in coordinated and high-tier games.[/i][list][*]Proximity Drone [SECONDARY][list][*]Cooldown :: 10s → 12s[/list][*]Base Speed: 460 → 455[/list][h3]Vyce[/h3][i]Vyce KOs a lot of people, so let’s see how she likes it now with her lower stagger!!![/i][list][*]Base Stagger :: 1300 → 1200[*]Stagger Growth Tier :: 375 → 300[*]Super Nova [SPECIAL][list][*][BUGFIX] Minimum cast time :: 0s → 0.25s[list][*]Due to how they were implemented, press and hold abilities were subverting the cast-time system that all abilities use and were effectively able to output hits faster than intended. We made a systemic change to normalize these abilities.[/list][/list][/list][h3]Zentaro[/h3][i]His special is pretty special am I right? Okay sorry, now it’s got a 5 second longer cooldown.[/i][list][*]Oni’s Blade [SPECIAL][list][*]Cooldown :: 35s → 40s[/list][/list][h3]Mako[/h3][i]Very prevalent in coordinated and high-tier play (like Nao), Mako needs a touch to ensure she isn’t domineering. [/i][list][*]Perfect Pitch [PRIMARY][list][*]Cooldown :: 7s → 8.5s[*][BUGFIX] Minimum cast time :: 0s → 0.15s[list][*]Due to how they were implemented, press and hold abilities were subverting the cast-time system that all abilities use and were effectively able to output hits faster than intended. We made a systemic change to normalize these abilities.[/list][/list][*]Drum and Base [SECONDARY][list][*][BUGFIX] Minimum cast time :: 0s → 0.25s[list][*]See above[/list][/list][/list][h3][b]AWAKENINGS[/b][/h3][list][*]Rotated out:[list][*]Specialized Training[*]Recovery Drone[*]Among Titans[/list][*]Rotated in: [list][*]Glass Cannon[*]Big Fish[*]Perfect Form[/list][/list][h3]Perfect Form[/h3][i]IT’S BACK BUT WEAKER THAN LAST TIME. YOU MAY NOT LIKE IT, BUT THIS FORM IS PERFECT. SURELY WE WON’T CHANGE IT EVER AGAIN.[/i][list][*]Normal hit cooldown reduction :: 20% (max 2s) → 15% (Max 1.5s)[*]Light hit cooldown reduction :: 6.66% (max 0.66s) → 5% (Max 0.5s)[/list][h3]Orb Ponderer[/h3][list][*]Orb Cooldown Reduction (Before max stacks) :: 15% → 17.5%[/list][h3]Rampage[/h3][list][*]Base Size: 5% → 7.5%[/list][h3]Reptile Remedy[/h3][list][*]Max stagger increase: 350 → 400[/list][h3]Slick Kicks[/h3][i]Slick Kicks has been straight up really good for the past 10 years. Let’s try to give other Forward gear some love. [/i][list][*]Speed boost duration 1.5 → 1.25[/list][h3]Stacks on Stacks[/h3][list][*]Speed per stack :: 0.08% → 0.075%[list][*](Max speed :: 12/24% → 11.25/22.5%)[/list][/list][h3]Stinger[/h3][i]Increasing the duration of burns from Stinger so that quick reapplications of the debuff are weaker. This’ll be particularly noticeable when multiple people take Stinger and try and burn you to death.[/i][list][*]Duration :: 2.5s → 4s (Damage per second effectively reduced from 3% → 2%)[list][*]Note: Stinger does not prevent stagger regen so this won’t keep you from healing any longer than before.[/list][*]Burn :: 7.5% (2.5% for LIGHT hits) → 8% (2.66% for LIGHT hits)[/list][h3]Twin Drive[/h3][list][*]Secondary Cooldown Increase :: 5% → 2.5%[/list][h3]Vicious Vambrace[/h3][i]VV hasn’t really been poppin for a while. With the global stagger increase with the last big patch, VV was effectively healing you less. This should help it be decent again. [/i][list][*]Heal% :: 40% → 45%[*]Core Heal% :: 8% → 9%[/list][h1][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h1][list][*]Mako Japanese VO is once again Japanese.[*]Zentaro Secondary dash will now travel full distance over terrain.[*]Modified amount of time before Asher special starts applying hits to reduce leaks during it spawn.[*]Rasmus secondary should no longer occasionally fail to cast. (Let us know if it does)[*]Multiple awakenings that reduce the base cooldown of an ability should now always stack correctly.[*]Fixed a bug where players using controllers could sometimes stop the core in place.[*]Player reports now show confirmation of successful report submission.[*]Slot swap UI should now be correct for all languages.[*]Various small bug fixes.[/list]

notes.title: Omega Strikers - May 9th Micropatch | Update Notes
notes.notes:
Welcome Strikers to the patch notes of the May 9th, 2024 Micropatch!
Please remain seated and keep all arms and legs inside the ride as we take you on an exciting journey of map rotations, Striker adjustments, Awakening changes, and the return of Orbs.
That’s right, the orb map is back, so we're bringing the orb awakenings back with it! (Kind of, lol)

[h1][b]STRIKERS[/b][/h1][h3]Asher[/h3][i]Strikes CD is being brought up to match Quick Strikes now that the global CD is gone. Also adding some strength to her Breakthrough to KILL PEOPLE[/i][list][*]Breakthrough [SECONDARY][list][*]Strike CD reduction on her side of the field 15% → 20%[*]Knockback and Damage :: 130(+65% Power) → 140(+70% Power)[*]Core Knockback :: 1240(+130% Power) → 1260 (+140% Power)[/list][/list][h3]Atlas[/h3][i]Atlas has struggled finding his sure ground this year, so now he peers ahead to make his path clear. That's iambic pentameter I just really wanted to do that. But for real, Atlas hasn’t been doing great so far in Season 3 so we’re letting him project a little further into the future. [/i][list][*]Astral Projection [PRIMARY][list][*]Damage & Knockback :: 170(+85% Power) → 180 (+90% Power)[*]Core Knockback :: 1320 (+170% Power) →  1340 (+180% Power)[*]Lifetime :: 0.65 → 0.70  (Effective range 450 → 480)[/list][/list][h3]Era[/h3][i]This witch can be quite annoying in some cases because of that beam you know what I mean?
