This will help her do so because we don’t have the bug where Stinger did 90% of enemy Max HP like it did in one of our playtests by accident.[/i][list][*]Friend Fling [PRIMARY][list][*]KB & Damage :: 185 (+92% Power) → 200 (+100%Power)[*]Core KB :: 1350 (+185% Power) → 1380 (200% Power)[/list][/list][h3]Kai[/h3][i]Small adjustment from the divergent base stats that will stop Kai from really outclassing other forwards.[/i][list][*]Stagger Growth Tier :: 425 → 250[*]Base Stagger :: 1200 → 1150[/list][h3]Octavia[/h3][i]HUGE buff [/i][list][*]Flow State [SECONDARY][list][*]Cooldown :: 18s → 17s[/list][/list][h3]Rune[/h3][i]HUUUUUUGE buff [/i][list][*]Base Speed :: 450 → 460[/list][h1]Map Rotation[/h1][h3]Rotated OUT[/h3][list][*]Demon Dais[*]Oni Village[/list][h3]Rotate IN[/h3][list][*]Atlas's Lab[*]Ahten City[/list][h1][b]AWAKENINGS[/b][/h1][h3]Rotated OUT[/h3][list][*]Knife's Edge[*]Demolitionist[*]Timeless Creator[/list][h3]Rotated IN[/h3][i]Orbs are back baby and I know you love it. We brought back and adjusted both Orb Dancer and Orb Ponderer. We wanted to “flatten” their strength curve so that compared to the previous iteration they perform better on average but have a lower top-end. We’re also keeping Orb Replicator out to prevent some snowballing with these changes.[/i][list][*]Orb Dancer [Retuned][*]Orb Ponderer [Retuned][*]Catalyst[/list][h3]Aerials[/h3][list][*]Movement/Haste buff :: 70% → 75%[/list][h3]Hotshot[/h3][list][*]Core hit amp :: 12% → 13%[/list][h3]Might of the Colossus[/h3][list][*]Power scaling per size :: 0.75 → 0.65[/list][h3]Orb Dancer[/h3][list][*]Speed Increase per orb :: 40% → 30%[*]Speed increase per orb at max stacks :: 80% → 60%[*]Max Stacks :: 10 → 5[*]Duration :: 6s → 4.5[/list][h3]Orb Ponderer[/h3][list][*]Active cooldowns reduced per orb :: 25% → 15%[*]Cooldown reduction per orb at max stacks :: 45% → 30%[*]Max stacks :: 10 → 5[/list][h3]Reptile Remedy[/h3][list][*]Heal :: 4.5% → 5%[*]Duration :: 3s → 4s[/list][h3]Stacks on Stacks [/h3][i]We’re trying something new on our pancakes where they take longer to stack but are stronger at max, making them more important to protect but also putting a bigger target on your back![/i][list][*]Max stacks :: 100 → 150[*]Speed per stack :: 0.1 → 0.08 (Max speed 10%/20% → 12%/24%)[/list][h3]Stinger [/h3][list][*]Burn :: 9% → 7.5% (Light Hits: 3% → 2.5%)[/list][h3]Team Player[/h3][list][*]Allied strike power buff :: 20% → 22.5% [/list]

[hr][/hr]

Alright with that patch note stuff outta they way I just wanna drop in for a sec and say I saw some stuff that you all have been posting on the World Wide Web about OS and just wanted to post up a reminder of what’s happening on our end.
While it’s true that, as previously announced, most of the team have moved onto other projects, (which are still open for playtest applications [url=https://forms.gle/yeBgR8ksA5YGKzvu5]here [/url]btw.) but a couple of us are still working on [b]small quality-of-life stuff[/b] for Omega Strikers. For the future, we still want to bring some smaller updates to you all like:[list][*]New seasons[*]Recolors as skins for season rewards[*]Additional Battlepass Levels[*]Community-made emotes, titles, nameplates, etc.[/list]For the next update patch, we’re just going to have some bug fixes and a couple smaller things. All that being said, we’re so stoked that you’ve been sticking with us so far and have been playing OS, enjoying the matches, and giving us feedback on everything we’ve done!! We hope you continue to do so into the future and we’ll see you soon <3

notes.title: Omega Strikers - April 17th Micropatch | Update Notes
notes.notes:
Hey gang, how’s the new season going?? Are ya winnin' son?
You all had some things to say about the new season and we are listening!! 
This micropatch is live NOW with a couple of changes you probably will welcome.
Let us BEGIN!~
[hr][/hr]
[h1][b]SYSTEM CHANGES[/b][/h1][h2]New Gameplay Rule[/h2]We’ve heard your feedback on this one. We’re reverting the "ability cooldown from striking the core" change that came with the Season 3 update. The original goal was to add additional gameplay depth by giving players the opportunity to make more dynamic decisions around what to do with the Core once they have possession. However, it’s become apparent that this new rule has negatively impacted game pacing and promoted some unhealthy play patterns. [list][*]Hitting the CORE with an ability will continue to reset your STRIKE cooldown (once per ability cast). [*][b][strike]Hitting the CORE with strike now reduces your ability cooldowns [/strike](Removed)[/b][/list][h2]Maps and Modes[/h2][h3]Ranked[/h3][list][*]We’re aware of the issue of not displaying which team is 1st pick in the draft order.[list][*]We’re exploring some solutions to see if we can amend this in a future patch. [/list][/list][h1][b]STRIKERS[/b][/h1][h3][b]Atlas[/b][/h3][i]The weight of the world is proving a little much for Atlas. We're increasing the uptime of his ranged tools to compensate him.[/i][list][*]Astral Projection [PRIMARY][list][*]Cooldown :: 9s → 8.5s[/list][/list][h3][b]Finii[/b][/h3][i]Finii was kinda bad, now she will be good?[/i][list][*]Base Stats[list][*]Speed :: 460 → 470[*]Power :: 90 → 95[/list][/list][h3][b]Kai[/b][/h3][i]Goalie Kai is running circles around the competition, we're bumping his cooldowns a touch to give the rest of the cast some breathing room. As much as Kai probably dislikes that.[/i][list][*]Barrage [PRIMARY][list][*]Cooldown :: 11s → 12s[/list][*]Giga Blast [SPECIAL][list][*]Cooldown :: 20s → 22s[/list][/list][h3][b]Mako[/b][/h3][i]Mako’s struggling to find her footing this patch. With this change she may knock some other players off their footing too, so I guess that makes them even?[/i][list][*]Perfect Pitch [PRIMARY][list][*]Projectile Base PvP Damage and Knockback :: 100 (+50% Power) → 105 (+52.5% Power)[list][*]i.e. Fully charged player hit with no Awakenings :: 310 → 326[/list][*]Projectile Base Core Knockback :: 1180 (+100% Power) → 1190 (+105% Power)[list][*]i.e. Fully Charged Core hit with no Awakenings :: 1613 → 1632[/list][/list][/list][h3][b]Octavia[/b][/h3][i]Reverting this preemptive nerf on Octavia. She did not need it. Sorry Octy.[/i][list][*]Flow State [SECONDARY][list][*]Cooldown :: 20s → 18s[/list][/list][h3][b]X[/b][/h3][i]X got way too buff way too fast this patch… what’s his diet anyway? We are stepping and hitting him with some immediate action from us.[/i][list][*]Bell Ringer [PRIMARY][list][*]Cooldown :: 8s → 10s[/list][*]Bull Rush [SECONDARY][list][*]PvP Damage and Knockback :: 210 (+105% Power) → 190 (+95% Power)[*]Core Knockback :: 1385 (+202.5% Power) → 1360 (+190% Power)[/list][*]X Strike [SPECIAL EMPOWERED STRIKE][list][*]Strike Diameter :: 325 → 315 [/list][/list][h1][b]AWAKENINGS[/b][/h1][h3]Might of the Colossus[/h3][i]The Colossus was a bit more mighty than we intended.[/i][list][*]Power per 1% Size :: 1 → 0.75[/list][h3]Stinger[/h3][i]I’m allergic to bees :( [/i][list][*]Normal hit burn :: 10% → 9%[*]Light hit burn :: 3.33% → 3%[/list][h3]Reptile Remedy[/h3][i]This remedy wasn’t able to keep up with the damage, we're increasing its healing powers with some new ingredients.[/i][list][*]Missing health heal per second :: 3% → 4.5%[/list][h3]Quick Strike[/h3][i]Since we’re removing the strike CD change, we’re reverting the Quick Strike nerf that was affected by it. GOOD DAY STRIKERS!!
We're here with Omega Strikers update 4 POINT 0!!!!!!!
We've got some new things we cooked up for you, ranging from a new friends list, new awakenings, new custom game options, and new gameplay changes to like every striker! (Keep reading for that)
This will also mark the beginning of A NEW SEASON!!!
With all of that out of the way, let us begin.

 [hr][/hr]

[h1][b]SYSTEM CHANGES[/b][/h1]

[*]

[*]

[list]
[*]

[h2]Divergent Base Stats[/h2]
[list]
[*]
Strikers now have different initial speed/power/stagger.
[list]
[*]
Each striker is currently on a "tier" of the new base stats, but we these stats will likely branch out in the future.
[*]
On average, strikers recieved an increase to their base stagger to dampen damage-focused playstyles moving into 4.0
[*]
For example, in general, bigger characters will have more power and stagger but will be slower in contrast to smaller characters. These changes are also to help strikers develop their unique themes and sharpen their identities. 
[*]
Also, this will serve as another balance lever for us![/list][/list]
[h2]New Gameplay Rule[/h2]
[i]We want to reward players for their sickass dribbling and passses while further disincentivize pingponging, so we're changing things up a bit. This new strike/ability adjustment should open up room for some new combos on many strikers while also shaking up "optimal" playstyles for everyone else. You can probably expect cooldown increases to strikers in future patches as we fine tune the game with these new rules. [/i]
[list]
[*]

[*]

[*]

notes.title: March 19 Micropatch + Season Reset Info!
notes.notes:
[b]yo gamers[/b]
We got a couple things we want to talk about with you all today - namely a small micropatch to tweak some characters that we noticed (or heard from you) needed... tweaking and some info on the [b]SEASON RESET.[/b] Make sure you read everything here so you know what's going on. (I know it's a lot and I don't have a cute VTuber bat girl to read it to you, but you gotta read it all!!!)

Anyway, let's kick it off with the Season Reset Info. I posted this on Discord a few weeks ago, but there's been some slight tweaks and extra things, so check it out if you haven't or get a refresher. 
[hr][/hr]
[h1]Season Reset
[/h1]

[h2]We're aiming for the reset to happen EARLY APRIL [/h2]

So keep up (or start) YOUR CLIMB. 
Now I know what you’re thinking, “BUT AESOP THE LAST RESET WAS KINDA WACK” Well, we took all your feedback and cooked up some new stuff for this reset. Last season reset we identified a couple problems: [list][*]Player ranks were too greatly reset, which felt like it was a waste to climb.[*]Hidden rating wasn't maintained, so it took way too long to reclimb to old ranks (and we had a bug that prevented us from fixing that swiftly)[*]Players couldn’t access central servers in some places (Particularly NA)[*]Duo/Trio limits were rough and created a big rift at higher tiers[/list] [h1]SO, we made lots of tweaks.[/h1]For the next season reset, we're going to be implementing the following changes: [list][*]New rank reset parameters (more on this below!)[*]Retaining hidden rating (to a degree where you won't have to climb forever just to get where you were last season)[*]Making sure players keep Central server access (though since Central server capacity is very limited, we maybe have to raise the entry threshold later on into the season)[*]Allowing Duos in all ranks and Trios in challenger[*]New rank rewards! (more on this below too!)[/list] As for the reset parameters, simply put, the rank reset will not put you lower than 2 ranks below your season end rank.
For example, ending in Challenger will reset you somewhere to Plat - Diamond, Diamond will reset you to Gold - Plat, Plat to Gold - Silver, etc. 
And, like I mentioned previously, you will still retain most of your hidden MMR from last time. So if you're reset to Gold and retained your Diamond hidden MMR, you'll climb quickly.

[b]Also, I mentioned RANKED REWARDS right?![/b]  We’ll be handing out some things like: [list][*]Aqua Cannon goal explosion[list][*](This isn't a seasonal reward btw, this is a forever thing that you'll unlock once you hit challenger any time in the future.)[/list][*]Top "x" titles[list][*]ex: Top 5, Top 10, Top 20, etc[/list][*]A skin recolor! (who it is I shall not say yet, but it’s someone without a skin hehe)[*]An emote for reaching plat[*]An emote for playing a bunch of games[/list] ^ Requirements to unlock these are pretty confirmed [b]BUT ARE SUBJECT TO CHANGE!!![/b]

Most rewards will be based on your Season *Peak* rating, but the titles for "Top X%" will be based on your leaderboard position at the end of the season.

We'll also have monthly exclusive "Title Awards" for those with the top 5 or so most goals, saves, KOs, etc!

*[i]Unfortunately we can't do a new battlepass with the limited resources we have, but we're hoping the rank rewards at least make up for some of that a little bit[/i].

So yea. We're pretty confident that these changes will make a season reset like 1,000,000x better. (You cannot quote me on that)

Also THATS NOT ALL THO We're also trying to explore more minor gameplay changes/updates (not limited to just balance fixes) for a future season!!! Though I can't give you details yet, or if it’s something we can even do still, but stay tuned for that because we're still testing all of it.
[hr][/hr]
[h1]Micropatch[/h1]
Alright, for those of you that are still with me (Which it better be EVERYONE), here's the deets of the micropatch. Like I mentioned above, it's just a couple small tweaks to a few things!

[h2]Strikers[/h2][b]Asher[/b][list][*]Barrier Beam [PRIMARY][list][*]Shield on her side of the field size reduced by 14%[/list][/list] [b]Estelle[/b][list][*]Piercing Shot [PRIMARY][list][*]Cooldown :: 9 → 10[/list][/list][b]Mako[/b][list][*]Ensnare Drums [SPECIAL][list][*]Cooldown :: 45s → 40s[/list][/list] [b]Zentaro[/b][list][*]Slashing Strike (STRIKE PASSIVE)[list][*]Hits until passive activated: 12 → 16[/list][/list][h2]Awakenings[/h2][b]Chronoboost[/b][list][*]Buff/Debuff duration :: 20% → 22.5%[/list][b]Recovery Drone[/b][list][*]Size 30 → 25%[/list][b]Spark of Agility[/b]: [list][*]Speed per spark 6% → 5%[/list][b]Spark of Leadership[/b][list][*]Allied Spark Effect Gain: 40% →30%[*]Cooldown: 5 → 4[*]Stagger: 150 → 125[*]Power: 8 → 6[*]Speed: 2% → 1%[/list][b]Spark of Strength[/b][list][*]Power per spark 22 → 20[/list][b]Unstoppable [/b][list][*]Recharge time :: 7.5 → 7[/list]

notes.title: Omega Strikers - December 15th Micropatch | Update Notes
notes.notes:
[i]Hey gang!

So let me start this out with a quick note: Sonii was pretty clumsy the other day and accidentally flew into some power lines on the way to the office, so we won't have a video for you all while she recovers... NONETHELESS, we've got a quick Micropatch for you all today with a couple little tweaks for your favorite characters. Not a HUGE change list, but we're tweaking a couple characters and awakenings so you'll want to check it out ANYWAY!! 

Okay. Let us begin!
[/i]

[h2][b]Strikers[/b][/h2]
[h3]Asher[/h3]
[i]The buff lady needs a buff because recently the buff lady was not so buff.
[/i][list]
[*]
BREAKTHROUGH [SECONDARY]
[list]
[*]
Cooldown :: 17s → 15s[/list][/list]
[h3]Finii[/h3]
[i]We hit this brat with some damage nerfs a couple patches ago, so now she's a little weak. She'll get some correction in terms of a buff in a different aspect. [/i]
[list]
[*]
TRIPLE TAKE [SECONDARY]
[list]
[*]
Cast range :: 850 → 900[/list][/list]
[h3]Juno[/h3]
[i]Juno strong. All around. Strong. Blob goal. This help. 
[/i][list]
[*]
BLOB BOUNCE [SECONDARY]
[list]
[*]
Cooldown :: 9s → 11s[/list][/list]
[h3]Kazan[/h3]
[i]Following his mini-rework type beat, we observed he landed pretty much where we wanted, but his numbers looked strong, most notably at higher skill levels. He was also giga brawling a lot. [/i]
[list]
[*]
CROOKED LEVERAGE [CLOSED PRIMARY]
[list]
[*]
Cooldown :: 7.5s → 8.5s
[*]
PvP damage :: 110 (+55% Power) → 100 (+50% Power)
[list]
[*]
Knockback values unchanged[/list][/list]
[*]
THE SLIP/POP-UP[CLOSED SECONDARY SPECIAL COMBO]
[list]
[*]
PvP damage and knockback :: 120 (+60% Power) → 110 (+55% Power)
[*]
Core knockback :: 1220 (+120% Power) → 1200 (+110% Power)[/list][/list]
[h3]Luna[/h3]
[i]Luna is pretty strong and manages to get goals or KOs from fishing for frequent across-map B.O.O.S.Ts. [/i]
[list]
[*]
B.O.O.S.T. [SECONDARY]
[list]
[*]
Cooldown :: 12s → 15s[/list][/list]
[h3]Mako[/h3]
[i]Makos were using Drum and Base as an instant era-like buff which was pretty strong (and in this community manager's opinion, CRINGE). We're adjusting that to change the behavior but buffing her primary to compensate. [/i]
[list]
[*]
DRUM AND BASE [SECONDARY]
[list]
[*]
Size and Haste linger after cast :: 1.5s → 0.5s
[list]
[*]
Duration while channeling unchanged[/list][/list]
[*]
PERFECT PITCH [PRIMARY]
[list]
[*]
Minimum hold duration for projectile :: 0.25s → 0.15s
[*]
Projectile range increased slightly at all points in the cast
[list]
[*]
Minimum range :: 258.75 → 270
[*]
Maximum range :: 1310 → 1367[/list][/list][/list]
[h3]Rune[/h3]
[i]Rune was STRONG. We made him LESS STRONG. But it might've been a little too LESS STRONG. This should help balance him out a touch.[/i]
[list]
[*]
SHADOW STEP [SECONDARY]
[list]
[*]
Cooldown :: 12 → 10[/list][/list]
[h3]X[/h3]
[i]He's strong, but not that popular (based on Pick rate. In the world, he's definitely stupid popular I mean look at him.) This nerf will help bring him back to a nice even state.[/i]
BELL RINGER [PRIMARY]
[list]
[*]
PvP damage and knockback :: 200 (+100% Power) → 190 (+95% Power)
[*]
Core knockback :: 1380 (+200% Power) → 1360 (+190% Power)[/list]
BULL RUSH [SECONDARY]
[list]
[*]
PvP damage and knockback :: 220 (+110% Power) → 210 (+105% Power)
[*]
Core knockback :: 1390 (+205% Power) → 1385 (+202.5% Power)[/list]

[h2] [b]GEAR AND AWAKENINGS[/b][/h2]
[i]I wanted Rapid Fire again. What are you gonna do about it, punk?[/i]
[list]
[*] ROTATED OUT: Perfect Form
[*] ROTATED IN: Rapid Fire
[/list]
[h3]Demolitionist[/h3]
[i]Demolitionist was just straight up pretty strong. 
[/i][list]
[*]
Cooldown refund :: 8s → 6s[/list]
[h3]Fight or Flight[/h3]
[i]Wake up babe new Slick Kicks 2 just dropped. 
[/i][list]
[*]
Speed boost duration :: 1.5s → 1.75s[/list]
[h3]Reverberation[/h3]
[i]Reverberation wasn't at its peak performance, now it is. Hopefully.
[/i][list]
[*]
Cooldown Rate per 100 Stagger :: 1.15 → 1.25[/list]
[h3]Specialized Training[/h3]
[i]Specialized Training? More like Unspecialized Training. Hey Siri what's the opposite of specialized
[/i][list]
[*]
Special PvP hit modifier :: +50% → +40%
[*]
Special Core hit modifier :: +10% → +8%[/list]
[h3]Stagger Swagger[/h3]
[i]Stag Swag was too strong at higher elos, but too weak at lower elos. [/i]
[list]
[*]
Base speed :: 10% → 12%
[*]
Heal per second at low health :: 200 → 150[/list]

notes.title: Omega Strikers - November 30th Update | Update Notes
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=yyRHFdvMGUY;full][/previewyoutube]

Hello dear friends! Welcome to patch 3.2 of your favorite game, Omega Strikers! Today, we've got a plethora of new things headed your way to your favorite game Omega Strikers! Additions to your favorite game Omega Strikers include a thunderous new Oni that goes my the name Mako, a new drum n baseball themed map, new events, and more!

This isn't the last patch either - we've got a couple more things cooking up that we'll be shipping to you in your favorite game Omega Strikers, so keep an eye out for that.
So, without further ado, let us begin today's patch notes of your favorite game Omega Strikers.

[h1][b]SYSTEM CHANGES[/b][/h1]
[h2]MAPS AND MODES[/h2]
[h3][NEW] Taiko Temple[/h3]
Somebody started playing drums on a baseball field and thus Taiko Temple was born! ...At least I think that's the lore? (It probably isn't, guess you'll have to partake in the Oni event).  Smash the core and enemies into the drums for some extra bounce, then round the bases after your home run. 
[h3]Maps Rotation[/h3]
[list]
[*] Rotated Out: Night Market, Atlas's Lab 
[*] Rotated In: Taiko Temple, Ai.Mi's App
[/list]

Maps' Chance to Roll: All existing maps have an equal chance to roll in Ranked play.  In normal and quick play, Taiko Temple will have a heightened percentage for the first weekend of the patch. 

[h2]Custom Games[/h2]
[i]Continued improvements to custom games! We want to make it even easier for you to join up some customs with the homies, so now we have a custom game browser![/i]
[list]
[*]
Create a Custom Lobby
[list]
[*]
Public/Private room
[*]
Lobby Size
[*]
Spectators enabled/disabled[/list]
[*]
Browse Custom Lobbies
[list]
[*]
Search by Lobby name/ owner
[*]
Filter by game mode / lobby size / map etc.[/list][/list]
[h2]Skins/Content[/h2]
[i]Dreams and Nightmares. Nameplates. Titles. Emotes. You pick.[/i]
[list]
[*]
New Skins!
[list]
[*]
Alpharad Rune
[*]
Dream Era
[*]
Nightmare Era
[*]
Nightmare Vyce[/list]
[*]
New Nameplates!
[list]
[*]
Creator Nameplates
[list]
[*]
Alpharad
[*]
IKeepIt Taco... again
[*]
Mang0
[*]
Nyanners[/list]
[*]
Pro Team Nameplates
[list]
[*]
One for each canon team![/list][/list][/list]
[h2][b]STRIKERS[/b][/h2]
[h3][NEW] Mako[/h3]
[i]We're finally getting the band back together!  Mako is the final piece of the puzzle for the Oni twins - and for your team comp! She's got plenty of tools to defend the net or hit a home run by using her trusty bats and Taiko drums to beat down enemies, amp up allies, and snare the Core. So if you're up against Mako, be sure to bring some ear plugs, it's gonna get loud!!   [/i]

[url=https://youtu.be/pa8A1ethBl8]Watch her Character Trailer here![/url]

[list]
[*]
RHYTHM STRIKE / MAJOR BEAT(STRIKE PASSIVE)
[list]
[*]
Knock the Core in a direction with a LIGHT hit.
Every hit, gain a Beat. At 8 Beats, this Strike will be empowered with a larger size, more Core knockback, and it can hit enemy Strikers.[/list]
[*]
DRUM AND BASE [SECONDARY]
[list]
[*]
Push-and-hold this ability for up to 4s to push away enemies and BUFF all allies, granting 30% HASTE and 30% Size while drumming and for 1.5s after. Upon releasing the ability, emit a LIGHT shockwave that blasts enemies away from you. 
Gain a Beat upon using this ability and another every 1s it's held. [/list]
[*]
PERFECT PITCH [PRIMARY]
[list]
[*]
Push-and-hold to wind up a huge swing.  On release, swing the bat for a LIGHT hit. After .25ss the swing will also connect with a drum, launching it forward as a PROJECTILE.  Charge up to 1.25s for a stronger swing.
The wind up can be held for 2.5s. [/list]
[*]
ENSARE DRUMS [SPECIAL]
[list]
[*]
Launch your drums towards enemies as a PROJECTILE.  On hitting an enemy CREATE a trap that will let targets enter but will knock them back when they attempt to escape.  [/list][/list]
[h3]Ai.Mi[/h3]
[i]Ai.Mi was racking up the dubs at elite tiers while eating Ls at lower ranks. We're hoping this change evens her out for everyone.[/i]
[list]
[*]
FIREWALL SENTRY [SPECIAL]
[list]
[*]
Cooldown :: 35s → 30s
[*]
PvP Damage & Knockback :: 125 (+62.5% Power) → 115 (+57.5% Power)
[*]
Core Knockback unchanged[/list][/list]
[h3]Asher[/h3]
[i]Call us the exterminators because we're DESTROYING these Asher bugs. For good measure, we're giving her a few extra changes to get her back on her feet.[/i]
[list]
[*]
BARRIER BEAM [PRIMARY]
[list]
[*]
Barrier duration now scales with creation duration
[*]
Note: Barriers on enemy's side of the field still break after 1 hit[/list]
[*]
BREAKTHROUGH [SECONDARY]
[list]
[*]
Cooldown :: 18s → 17s
[*]
[BUGFIX] Adjusted her dash hitbox to hopefully prevent cases where she is unable to buffer her dash→ strike combo[/list]
[*]
PATHSPLITTER [SPECIAL]
[list]
[*]
[BUGFIX] Now hits all overlapping enemies when transforming to prevent cores from sneaking through[/list][/list]
[h3]Dubu[/h3]
[i]Dubu was often becoming a ghost from getting knocked out so often... maybe that's what inspired DuBoo?[/i]
[list]
[*]
Stagger growth :: 500 → 600
[*]
SOMERASSAULT [SECONDARY]
[list]
[*]
Cooldown :: 20s → 19s[/list][/list]
[h3]Finii [/h3]
[i]THE BIGGEST MOST IMPACTFUL CHANGE OF OMEGA STRIKERS HISTORY. FINII'S ABILITY IS NAMED CORRECTLY.[/i]
[list]
[*]
DOUBLE TAKE → TRIPLE TAKE [SECONDARY][/list]
[h3]Kazan[/h3]
[i]Kazan has proven to be frustrating for others to face off against, even when he's not finding much success on the field. We are shifting his playstyle away from being an attrition brawler and more towards a mix of core-control/brawler depending on his form. This is a pretty hefty change, so we'll be watching him closely and keeping an ear out for feedback and will be counting on you all to help us steer him in the right direction if you aren't feeling these changes.[/i][i]TL;DR : Kazan's closed umbrella form is being adjusted to be better at core controlling (and worse at brawling) while his open form is being tuned to be better at knocking people out. We also hit him with a couple quality of life changes.[/i]
[list]
[*]
CROOKED LEVERAGE [CLOSED PRIMARY]
[list]
[*]
Hit type ::[b] Normal → Light [/b](<- this is important)
[*]
PvP damage :: 140 (+70% Power) → 110 (+55% Power)
[*]
PvP knockback (if staggered) :: 170 (+85% Power) → 250 (+125% Power)
[*]
Core knockback Unchanged
[*]
Cooldown :: 11s → 7.5s
[*]
Channel time :: 0.2 → 0.125
[*]
Linger time :: 0.5 → 0.35
[list]
[*]
This will reduce the duration that Kazan is stuck after a missed PRIMARY[/list][/list]
[*]
THE SLIP/POP-UP [CLOSED SECONDARY SPECIAL COMBO]
[list]
[*]
Hit type :: [b]Normal → Light [/b](<- this is important)
[*]
PvP damage & knockback :: 140 (+70% Power) → 120 (+60% Power)
[*]
Core knockback :: 1260 (+140% Power) → 1220 (+120% Power)
[*]
Cooldown :: 11s → 10s
[*]
Hitbox size :: 350 → 475
[*]
[BUGFIX] Super Surge no longer amplifies Pop-Up's damage. 
[*]
[BUGFIX] No longer instantly warps to the maximum range of dash if dash attack special is triggered while in terrain.[/list]
[*]
TOP SPIN [OPEN PRIMARY]
[list]
[*]
PvP damage & knockback :: 170 (+85% Power) → 220 (110% Power)
[*]
Core knockback :: 1320 (+170% Power) → 1390 (205% Power)
[*]
Push effect prior to final hit :: Reduced by 60%
[*]
Improved ability to capture core during the spin.[/list]
[*]
CARRIED AWAY / MADDENING DESCENT [OPEN SECONDARY SPECIAL COMBO]
[list]
[*]
PvP damage & knockback :: 200 (+100% Power) → 230 (+115% Power)
[*]
Core Knockback :: 1380 (+200% Power) → 1395 (+207.5% Power)[/list]
[*]
POP/RETRACT [SPECIAL]
[list]
[*]
Cooldown :: 3s → 1.5s[/list][/list]
[h3]Nao[/h3]
[i]Nao's power went to the moon with our last set of (back-to-back) changes. These should bring her back to earth. Sell sell sell![/i]
[list]
[*]
Stagger growth :: 450 → 250
[*]
Proximity Drone :: 
[list]
[*]
Cooldown :: 10 → 12
[*]
PvP Damage and Knockback :: 140 (+70% Power) → 110 (+55% Power)
[*]
Core Knockback :: 1260 (+140% Power) → 1200 (+110% Power)
[*]
Disarm Time :: 0.8 →0.6[/list][/list]
[h3]Rune[/h3]
[i]For real please stop banning Rune!! He's nerfed again, you can play him!![/i]
[list]
[*]
UNSTABLE ANOMALY [PRIMARY]
[list]
[*]
Cooldown :: 7.5 → 8
[*]
Core Knockback :: 1405(+212% Power) → 1175(+170% Power)
[*]
PvP Values unchanged[/list]
[*]
 SECONDARY
[list]
[*]
Core Knockback :: 1405(+212% Power) → 1175(+170% Power)
[*]
[BUGFIX] PvP damage reduced to match PRIMARY :: 250 (+125% Power) → 200 (+100% Power)
[*]
PvP Knockback unchanged[/list][/list]
[h3]X[/h3]
[i]We buffed X a few patches ago and he was once again giving it to us. This is a light touch to make sure he doesn't continue to over perform![/i]
[list]
[*]
BULL RUSH [SECONDARY]
[list]
[*]
Cooldown :: 13 → 15[/list][/list]
[h3][b]GEAR AND AWAKENINGS[/b][/h3]
[i]Somebody picked up ALL THE ORBS and now they're gone again what the heck! We've taken out Orb awakenings while we wait for them to respawn, so try your hand at this brand-new batch of supportive awakenings! Titans will soon walk among us, so you can find new ways to lead your team to victory with all the giants walking around the field with this rotation.[/i][i]P.S. We've also DEMOLISHED some PANCAKES!![/i]
[h3][NEW] Among Titans[/h3]
[list]
[*]
Lose 30% Size and gain 15% Speed. Your teammates gain 15% Size.[/list]
[h3][NEW] Team Player[/h3]
[list]
[*]
Strikes hit the core 20% harder when aiming towards an ally. If that ally strikes the core within 1.5 seconds they will hit the core 20 % harder, if they strike towards an ally they can transfer this effect.[/list]
[h3][NEW] Spark of Leadership[/h3]
[list]
[*]
SPARK - Your Allies gain 50% of your SPARK effects. Gain 5 Cooldown Rate, 150 Stagger, 8 Power, and
2% Speed.[/list]
[h3][ROTATED OUT] :: Orb Dancer, Orb Ponderer, Orb Replicator, Stacks on Stacks[/h3]
[h3][ROTATED IN] :: Among Titans, Team Player, Spark of Leadership, Demolitionist [/h3]
[h3]Big Fish[/h3]
[i]Big Fish? More like...  Medium Fish? This should bring this awakening to more of like an Above Average Fish but Not Quite Huge Fish.[/i]
[list]
[*]
Size increase :: 25% → 30%[/list]
[h3]Glass Cannon[/h3]
[i]Glass cannon had too much time out of combat while it wasn't in the rotation. We'll reset its stacks to keep things fair.[/i]
[list]
[*]
Power per stack :: 8 → 6 
[*]
Speed per stack :: 4 → 3
[*]
Max stacks :: 4 → 6 
[*]
Time until fully charged :: 10s → 15s[/list]
[h3]Heavy impact[/h3]
[i]Heavy impact is a bit of an outlier in terms cooldown reduction so we're going to bring it into alignment with the other cooldown reducers.[/i]
[list]
[*]
Maximum cooldown reduced :: 14s → 7s[/list]
[h3]Peak Performance[/h3]
[i]With all his stagger buddies gone, this is no longer what Peak Performance looks like... Hopefully this change piques your interests and returns him to his former glory.[/i]
[list]
[*]
Speed conversion per 100 Stagger :: 0.5% → 0.6%[/list]
[h3]Primetime[/h3]
[i]Primetime has had a long fall from grace, and after giving others a chance to shine, it's coming back for its time slot.[/i]
[list]
[*]
Hit power Reduction:: 15% → 10%
[*]
Core Hit power reduction :: 3% → 2%[/list]
[h3]Siphoning Wand[/h3]
[i]Siphoning wand was too good on some Strikers and not good enough on everyone else. We're retuning it to be more in line with other awakenings by treating light hits and normal hits differently. We are giving it a small buff to make up for overall nerf it'll be taking.[/i]
[list]
[*]
Normal hit drain :: 5% → 6%
[*]
Light hit drain :: 5% → 2%
[*]
Heal amount :: 100% → 150% of damage dealt[/list]
[h3]Twin Drive[/h3]
[i]Oh, you want two abilities? Ha ha ha, sure. (Monkey's paw curls.) Twin Drive now lets you cast abilities twice, but it'll have a longer cooldown.[/i]
[list]
[*]
(Bug fix) Fixed a bug where Twin Drives cooldown reduction wasn't applying
[*]
Cooldown Modifier:: -5% → +7.5%
[list]
[*]
That's a nerf btw. Twin Drive makes your cooldowns 7.5% longer.[/list][/list]
[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]
[list]
[*]
Demolitionist no longer triggers multiple times per barrier.
[*]
The hole in the center of Ai.Mi's app will now correctly KO Strikers
[*]
Gates of Obscura no longer causes players to jitter around the map when dashing or getting knocked back.
[*]
Knockback resist is no longer granted in the enemy goal arc.
[*]
Drek'ar now correctly plays SFX when entering stealth.
[*]
Rapid Fire now correctly works on abilities with more than one charge.
[*]
Magnetized Soles tool-tip correctly reflects buffed duration of 1.5 seconds
[*]
Fixed missing VOs for Octavia, Vyce, Spirit Warden Zentaro, Magician Rasmus, and Pop King Kai
[*]
Adjusted Nao's MVP screen to use the correct camera angle.
[*]
Fixed tooltip for Nao's primary recast.
[*]
Various minor bugfixes.[/list]

[h1]Bonus![/h1]
We've got a couple pieces of absolutely KILLER merch for you to pick up!!

notes.title: Omega Strikers - November 16th Micropatch | Update Notes
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=XQq9q1UcZ1U;full][/previewyoutube]

Yo! We're back at it again at Odyssey Interactive with a micropatch! Today's micropatch is particularly micro, but is still patch! It'll feature some changes to characters you love! Or hate! I don't know how you play the game, I'm not one to judge! 
Alright, let us dig into it!!

[h3]Maps Rotation[/h3]
[i]It's getting cold in Ahten and the pipes of Inky's Splash Zone risk becoming frozen, so we're moving it into storage for a bit![/i]

Rotated in :: Ahten City, Demon Dais
Rotated out :: Oni Village, Inky's Splash Zone

[h2][b]Strikers[/b][/h2]
[h3]Finii[/h3]
[i]When it comes to damage, Finii is shining! Outside of that, she's a bit... dull? These changes intend to lower her damage while helping her control the field in other ways.[/i]
[list]
[*]
DOUBLE TAKE [SECONDARY]
[list]
[*]
Cooldown :: 10s → 8s
[*]
PvP damage :: 80 (+40% Power) → 50 (+25% Power)
[*]
Core knockback :: 1140 (+80% Power) → 1080 (+50% Power)[/list][/list]
[h3]Nao[/h3]
[i]Nao is still struggling to find her footing, particularly at higher tiers of play. We're hoping to hook her up with a competitive advantage by adding some much-needed consistency to her portfolio.[/i]
[list]
[*]
SENTRY DRONE [PRIMARY]
[list]
[*]
Cooldown :: 7s → 6s
[*]
Drone Duration :: 3.25 → 3.5[/list]
[*]
PROXIMITY DRONE [SECONDARY]
[list]
[*]
Cooldown :: 12s → 10s
[*]
Explosion radius :: 575 → 650[/list][/list]
[h3]Rasmus[/h3]
[i]Perhaps the extra data Nao has provided to him has helped Rasmus climb his way back to the top. To keep him in line, we're giving his Death Touch a... love tap.[/i]
[list]
[*]
DEATH TOUCH [SPECIAL]
[list]
[*]
Cooldown :: 18s → 20s[/list][/list]
[h3]Vyce[/h3]
[i]As usual, her sister was getting all the attention, so Vyce has slipped out of the limelight. We're giving her some playmaking tools so she can shine a bit as brightly as she once did.[/i]
[list]
[*]
THUNDERSTRUCK [SECONDARY]
[list]
[*]
Cooldown :: 16s → 14s
[*]
Teleport Recast window :: 3.25s → 3.75s[/list][/list]
[h2] [b]GEAR AND AWAKENINGS[/b][/h2]
[i]The Orb map is back, so we're bringing the Orb awakenings with it![/i]

ROTATED IN: Orb Dancer, Orb Ponderer, Orb Replicator
ROTATED Out: Tempo Swing, Bulk up, Reverberation

[h3]Chronoboost[/h3]
[i]Y'know, movement abilities also count as "buffs", so we'll be nerfing chronoboost to weaken those movement buff double dippers a touch. [/i]
[list]
[*]
Buff and Debuff duration increase :: 35% → 30%
[*]
Movement ability range increase :: 75% → 70%[/list]
[h3]Deadeye[/h3]
[i]While Deadeye's main users have no trouble making dead guys, it still falls a bit flat for the rest of the cast. We're making it a bit easier to trigger so more Strikers can take their turn sniping the competitors.[/i]
[list]
[*]
Range :: 600 → 550[/list]
[h3]Fight or Flight[/h3]
[i]Fight or Flight, aka 'Better Slick Kicks' was too good. We're changing it to "Better Slick Kicks but not as good as before."[/i]
[list]
[*]
Speed boost :: 20% → 15%[/list]
[h3]Magnetized Soles[/h3]
[i]Everyone in the city has been waiting in line before the store even opens to get their hands on Slick Kicks. We'd like to see if the other stylish footwear from Ahten City can give it a run for its money.[/i]
[list]

notes.title: The Future of Omega Strikers
notes.notes:
[h3]Hi everyone. 
[/h3]

We wanted to talk about the future of Omega Strikers, what it means for us, and what that means for you.

We made a quick video to talk about these things with two of the founders of Odyssey Interactive: Ody LUNCHBOY and Ody Maple.

[previewyoutube=oTywjFNYZ2U;full][/previewyoutube]

If you don't have time to watch the video, here's the gist:

• By the end of this year, the Odyssey team is pivoting to work on new games set in the Omega Strikers universe.

• Servers for Omega Strikers will stay on and we’ll continue releasing balance updates for the foreseeable future. We’re also planning to polish up the custom games tool and ship some other quality of life updates before the end of the year.

• But after this year there won’t be any more new skins, maps, strikers, awakenings, or Striker Passes.

• Any purchases you made in Omega Strikers will carry over as premium currency granted to you in our next game.

We go into more detail on this new FAQ page on our site: https://support.odysseyinteractive.gg/hc/en-us/articles/20078372545819

Lunchboy and Maple will be in our official Discord server answering any questions you may have, so please head over there to https://discord.gg/OmegaStrikers

Thanks for reading!

To: All Staff
From: Rasmus - President, Clarion Corp.
Subject: Omega Strikers Patch 3.1.0

Hello my loyal and dedicated Clarion Corp employees! I am writing you all to inform you of a couple changes coming to Clarion Corp.

First, I would like to announce that our very own Director of Special Projects, [b]Nao,[/b] will be joining the roster of Omega Strikers. Please send congratulations to her office.

Second, we are proud to announce the opening of [b]Clarion Corp Test Chamber[/b]. This new map will rotate between 5 "submaps" each game. We are very excited to observe this new map and monitor the strikers.

Finally, we will be hosting a [b]New Event[/b] to help us determine which of the temporary "superpowers"  is most favorable among the audience. We will analyze the data with Nao's assistance.
Also, on a personal note, I recently picked up a new hobby. If you see me, [b]Magician Rasmus,[/b] around, let me perform an illusion for you.

Find the details of all the changes below. Thank you.

[h1][b]SYSTEM CHANGES[/b][/h1]
[h2]MAPS AND MODES[/h2]
[h3][NEW] Clarion Test Chamber[/h3]
[list]
[*]
Deep underground below Clarion Corp HQ hides Rasmus' private Corestrike Arena.  However, there's more to this technological marvel than a simple love for the sport. Here is where Rasmus and Clarion Corp's Director of Special Projects, Nao are testing the effects of Omega energy on humans.  They've found a way to replicate the magic and technologies of some of the League's strongest strikers, and now they're using those powers to push the players to their limit...
[*]
The Test Chamber is an indoor Arena with 5 different 'variants.' Before each round, the Arena morphs into a new variant, changing its terrain and incorporating a new mechanic based on the powers of other strikers.  After each Set, the variants reset!
[list]
[*]

[*]

[*]
Use high-speed bumpers to send the core (and enemies) flying on [i]Project [b]BASS DROP[/b][/i]
[*]
Fight with your team to secure a massive size buff on [i]Project [b]MAELSTROM[/b][/i][/list][/list]
[h3]Maps Rotation[/h3]
[i]Like Awakenings, we'll now rotate maps in and out on occasion to highlight new options and improve the meta.  [/i]
Rotated Out: Oni Village, Atlas's Lab 
Active Rotation: We're reducing the number of maps in the active rotation from 6 to 5. We expect to rotate maps in and out more frequently during future patches and micropatches. The standard rule is that all maps have an equal chance to be selected.  
Clarion Test Weekend: In Normal and Quick Play queues, Clarion Test Chamber will have a heightened (50%) chance to be selected this weekend. On Monday, Normal and Quick Play queues will be changed back to have an equal chance for all maps in the active rotation to be selected.  Ranked queue percentage will be unchanged and follow the standard rule.
[h2][b]UI / Systems[/b][/h2]
[i]USE ENERGY BURST!!!!!!!!!!!!!! Something long requested - we've finally be able to add in some more callouts for all of your in-game communication needs[/i]
[list]

KO Them!
[*]
Get Orbs!

Sorry!
[*]
Use Energy Burst!
[*]
Spread Out!
[*]
Let Me Defend![/list]
[*]
no more "help help help..." sorry.[/list]
[h2]Custom Games[/h2]

Enable/Disable spectators

Premade lobby codes

Map selection

Server selection [/list]
[h2]Skins/Content[/h2]
[i]Not only Rasmus, Zentaro gets a skin too. Lookin' a little cyberpunk over there, dude. [/i]
[list]
[*]
Magician Rasmus

Neon Soul Zentaro[/list]
[h2][b]STRIKERS[/b][/h2]

notes.title: Omega Strikers - September 21st Micropatch | Update Notes
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=f6l-tI0Udas;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]What?? Is it that time again?  Yes, yes it is! We have some fresh faces and some old friends along for this micropatch. Some of our recent changes affected the likes of Asher and Rune a bit too much, so they'll have to be rebalanced. We also, however, have a good collection of buffs too; some Oni, some Blobbos, and... X?  [/i]

[i]One frequent visitor to these notes that you will not see below (this time) is our favorite trickster, Finii. She has been getting a lot of magical buffs almost every patch, but they haven't been sticking. We recognized we needed to do something a bit more flashy, so she'll be getting a larger set of changes next full patch! [/i]

[h2][b]STRIKERS[/b][/h2]
[h3]Asher[/h3]
[i]Asher, on the wings of some bugfixes (and some intended buffs) really carved her own path. We're reducing the effectiveness her SPECIAL has in locking people down, knocking them out, and scoring. We're also taking down her Barrier Beam damage substantially; it's proven too effective as a KO tool even without Awakenings backing it.[/i]
[list]
[*]
BARRIER BEAM [PRIMARY]
[list]
[*]
PvP Damage and Knockback :: 200 (+100% Power) → 175 (+87.5% Power)
[*]
Core Knockback :: 1380 (+200% Power) → 1330 (175% Power)[/list][/list]
[list]
[*]
PATHSPLITTER [SPECIAL]
[list]
[*]
Cooldown :: 35s → 40s
[*]
PvP Damage and Knockback :: 120 (+60% Power) → 100(+50% Power)
[*]
Core Knockback unchanged
[*]
[BUGFIX] :: Minimum stun time for the knockback is no longer .3s (unintentionally got reverted, which caused players to get locked down by the ability more)[/list][/list]
[h3]Era[/h3]
[i]Era is battling with the best of them. We're bumping the Bewitching Beam back to better balance.  [/i]
[list]
[*]
BEWITCHING BEAM [PRIMARY]
[list]
[*]
Cooldown :: 8s → 8.5s
[*]
Buff / Debuff Time :: 2.25s → 2s[/list][/list]
[h3]Finii[/h3]
[i]If you skipped the blurb at the beginning, first of all, how dare you, second of all: bigger Finii changes are coming in a future patch![/i]
[h3]Juliette[/h3]
[i]Juliette is the preeminent brawler at high MMRs and in tournaments. We're grounding her a bit, though she'll probably still rise from the ashes.  [/i]
[list]
[*]
FLYING PHOENIX [SECONDARY]
[list]
[*]
Cooldown :: 16s → 18s[/list][/list]
[h3]Juno[/h3]
[i]We gave players more control over Blobbos, but that unintentionally made her a bit harder to use. We're letting her Strike ‘suggestions' to Blobbos last a bit longer - and are upping her damage as well.[/i]

STRIKE WITH FRIENDS (STRIKE PASSIVE)
[list]
[*]

[*]
FRIEND FLING [PRIMARY]
[list]

[*]
Core Knockback :: 1320 (+170% Power) → 1350 (+185% Power)[/list][/list]
[h3]Rune[/h3]
[i]We might have given Obscura a bit too much power in the last micropatch. We're pulling back a bit on the range, and also pulling some power elsewhere from Unstable Anomaly to, well, stabalize it.[/i]
[list]
[*]
UNSTABLE ANOMALY [PRIMARY]
[list]
[*]
Cooldown :: 7s- >7.5s
[*]
PvP Damage :: 250 (+125% Power) → 200(+100% Power)
[*]
Range :: 750 → 700[/list][/list]
[h3]Vyce[/h3]
[i]We're making it so if you stick around for her show, it'll cost you. More visits to the School of Rock will end up in detention.  [/i]
[list]
[*]
POWER CHORD[PRIMARY]
[list]
[*]
PvP Damage and Knockback :: 170 (+85% Power) → 185 (+92.5% Power)
[*]
Core Knockback :: 1320 (+170% Power) → 1350 (+185% Power)
[*]
LIGHT chain hit damage and knockback unchanged[/list]
[*]
SUPER NOVA [SPECIAL]
[list]
[*]
Max PvP Damage and Knockback Multiplier for Full Charge :: 2.25x → 2.5x 
[*]
Max PvP Damage and Knockback :: 360 (+180% Power) → 400 (+200% Power)[/list][/list]
[h3]X[/h3]
[i]It's hard to hit things with your head, even when it's a big one!  We're giving X more opportunities and more payout for his difficult-to-land dashing attack. [/i]
[list]
[*]
BULL RUSH [SECONDARY]
[list]
[*]
Cooldown :: 14s → 13s
[*]
PvP Damage and Knockback :: 190 (+95% Power) → 200 (+100% Power)
[*]
Core Knockback :: 1360 (+190% Power) → 1380 (+200% Power)[/list][/list]
[h3]Zentaro[/h3]
[i]Zentaro has been on the receiving end of a lot of buffs and then a lot of nerfs. While he is most effective (and annoying) at whittling enemies down, we're giving him some better finishing power for one of his harder to hit abilities. [/i]
[list]
[*]
IAI RUSH [SECONDARY]
[list]
[*]
PvP Damage and Knockback :: 160 (+80% Power) → 180 (+90% Power)
[*]
Core Knockback :: 1300 (+160% Power) → 1340 (+180% Power)[/list][/list]

[h3][b]GEAR AND AWAKENINGS[/b][/h3]
[h3]Big Fish[/h3]
[i]Size isn't everything, but it is a VERY good stat. Like Stagger. In this case, Big Fish will remain big, but it will grant a bit less sturdiness.[/i]
[list]
[*]
Stagger :: 300 → 200[/list]
[h3]Bulk Up[/h3]
[i]Bulk Up has never been the belle of the ball. We suspect it still won't be the best in slot for most, but it should provide a better offensive contribution when you've accumulated a bunch of stagger.[/i]
[list]
[*]
Power per 100 max Stagger :: 1.5 → 1.75[/list]
[h3]Reverberation[/h3]
[i]Reverberation, like Bulk Up, grants good defense but doesn't really convert it meaningfully. We're taking a big swing here to make it live up to its promise. [/i]
[list]
[*]
Cooldown per 100 max Stagger :: .8 → 1.5[/list]
[h3]Sparks[/h3]
[i]Spark of Agility is overperforming largely due to its base stats. We're going to be pulling that back, but give better bonuses to its neighbors in Sparkington City as they are currently lackluster.[/i]
[h3]Spark of Agility[/h3]
[list]
[*]
Base Speed :: 2% → 1%
[*]
Speed per Spark :: 7% → 6% [/list]
[h3]Spark of Focus[/h3]
[list]
[*]
Base Cooldown Rate :: 2 → 4
[*]
Cooldown per Spark :: 10 → 12[/list]
[h3]Spark of Power[/h3]
[list]
[*]
Power per Spark :: 20 -> 22[/list]
[h3]Spark of Resilience[/h3]
[list]
[*]
Base Stagger :: 50 → 100 [/list]
[h3]Stacks on Stacks [/h3]
[i]The pancakes have always been a staple of the meta. Lately, though, it's risen to the top of the heap. We're bumping it down to a more reasonable place, so it doesn't stack up so well against the other options. [/i]
[list]
[*]
Speed per Stack :: .12% → .10%
[*]
Max Speed :: 24% → 20% [/list]

[previewyoutube=D-GamRy0qiU;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]Hey there Strikers. We're back for some more micro'ing.  In case you missed it, Kazan got some nerfs last Friday (September 1) and Finii got some bugfixes and buffs on our rogue off-schedule micropatch.  There were also some immediate bugfixes following the big splash that 3.0 made. (Thankfully X stopped infinitely striking your face into the dirt shortly after).  [/i]

[i]With all that behind us, though, we have a standard balancing patch and rotation for Awakenings.  Melee goalies are getting some taps down. [/i]
[h2][b]STRIKERS[/b][/h2]
[h3]Ai.Mi[/h3]
[i]Ai.MI has absolutely infected the hearts, minds, and computers of players. She's still our most popular Striker and is also winning a large proportion of her games.  One culprit is the usefulness of Firewall Sentry, given its relative (to her other abilities) ease of use.  [/i]

notes.title: Omega Strikers - Season 2 Patch Notes | Summer Splash
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=EpbvawmuIkI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]WELCOME TO OMEGA STRIKERS 3.0.[/h1]

Our fattest update yet, this patch features a TON of stuff. A CRAZY new striker, two crazy new maps, a new Striker Pass, new skins, and of course, AN ENTIRE VISUAL NOVEL. RIGHT THERE. IN THE GAME. 
With great changes comes great patch notes, so let's jump right into it. There's A LOT.

[h1][b]SYSTEM CHANGES[/b][/h1]
[h2]VISUAL NOVEL[/h2]
Yeah, you read that correctly. There's an ENTIRE VISUAL NOVEL now in Omega Strikers for Summer Splash.
Head to the beach with Asher, Juno, Estelle, X, Juliette, or Dubu! Progress through the event, hang out with your new friends, get to know them better, and unlock new stuff in game! There's even missions for you to complete, some of which will even grant you fresh new titles and emotes!
[h2]MAPS AND MODES[/h2]
[h3][NEW] Inky's Splash Zone[/h3]
[list]
[*]
We have a brand new map that's incredibly interactive and breaks the boundaries of our previous designs! It's always summer at Inky's Splash Zone, always wild, and everyone is always prone to getting SOAKED.  When you take down a barrier on this map, the corner without the barrier turns into a KO zone and gives your team access to a water blaster that'll knock enemies into the deep end.  [/list]
[h3][NEW] Gates of Obscura[/h3]
[list]
[*]
The Gates of Obscura take us in a different direction than the fun-loving Splash Zone.  Here, we'll explore the depths of the void and source of Rune's power.  The portals on the map will possibly get you turned-around and upside-down, but once you master them, you can melt the brains of your enemies and dominate the map.  There's crazy new angles on this map and things will get even spicier in Overtime, so keep your head on a swivel.[/list]
[h3]Maps Rotation[/h3]
[i]Like Awakenings, we'll now rotate maps in and out on occasion to highlight new options and improve the meta.  [/i]

[list]
[*] Rotated Out: Ahten City and Demon Dais will have their places taken by the new maps: Inky's Splash Zone and Gates of Obscura. 
[*] Maps' Chance to Roll: Historically it's been completely equal, but for the first weekend, Inky's Splash Zone will have a higher chance to appear! We'll probably highlight Gates of Obscura down the road as well!
[/list]
[h2][b]UI / Systems[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*]
Recast abilities now have a slightly different icon background color when they're reactivatable. Applies to:
[list]
[*]
Ai.Mi's PRIMARY
[*]
Era's SPECIAL
[*]
Finii's SPECIAL
[*]
Rasmus's SECONDARY
[*]
Vyce's SECONDARY
[*]
X's STRIKE[/list][/list]
[h2]Ranked[/h2]
[list]
[*]
It's (soft) reset time! Congratulations on your climb for this season. We hope you climbed to where you wanted and didn't tilt into oblivion. Let's see what new heights you can soar to in Season 2! 
[list]
[*]
Almost everyone will end up in silver or below, with the highest ranks (challenger and above) resetting to gold or platinum. [/list][/list]
[h2]Skins/Content[/h2]
Yeah there's A LOT OF NEW SKINS. Some in the shop, some in the Striker Pass!
[list]
[*]
Summer Splash
[list]
[*]
Asher
[*]
Juno
[*]
Estelle
[*]
X
[*]
Dubu
[*]
Juliette[/list]
[*]
Spirit Warden Zentaro
[list]
[*]
Blackheart Spirit Warden Zentaro
[*]
Ghostwood Spirit Warden Zentaro[/list]
[*]
Red Rose Estelle
[*]
Cat Butler Kai[/list]

[h2]Striker Pass[/h2]
[list]
[*]
There's a new Striker Pass in the shop, full of tons of new goodies!
[list]
[*] Grindable XP has been reduced by about 25% compared to the Season 1 pass
[/list]
[/list]
[h2][b]STRIKERS[/b][/h2]
[h3]ALL STRIKERS[/h3]
[i]We've seen some higher lethality overall during the early stages of matches than we'd like. We're giving strikers a bit more breathing room before the brawl becomes overwhelming.  [/i]
[list]
[*]
Base Stagger :: 1125 → 1200[/list]
[h3][NEW] Kazan[/h3]
[i]Say hello to our little frenzied enforcer. Kazan is... crazy, but he's got a soft side for family. Much like his personality, he has a wild and unique playstyle where he utilizes his umbrella in a variety of different ways - swapping forms, leaping about the map, and comboing his abilities together to be our most mechanically challenging Striker to date.  He's here to lend Clarion Corp a little extra muscle in exchange for their help curing his big Sis. [/i]
[list]
[*]
PRESS THE POINT (STRIKE)
[list]
[*]
Knock the Core with a LIGHT hit that has greater force generated by the point  of the umbrella.[/list]
[*]
THE SLIP [SECONDARY]
[list]
[*]
Dash a short distance, passing by all targets. [/list]
[*]
CARRIED AWAY [POPPED SECONDARY]
[list]
[*]
Float up in the air, becoming Elusive.  Elusive targets are invulnerable and untargetable.[/list]
[*]
CROOKED LEVERAGE [PRIMARY]
[list]
[*]
Hook all enemies in a line towards you.[/list]
[*]
TOP SPIN [POPPED PRIMARY]
[list]
[*]
LIGHTLY hit all enemies in a line, pushing them  towards the top of the umbrella. The umbrella will then spin rapidly, dealing multiple LIGHT hits leading up to a final, more powerful flourish..[/list]
[*]
POP/RETRACT [SPECIAL] 
[list]
[*]
Pop open or Retract the umbrella, unlocking a different set of abilities per form. 
[b]Maddening Descent[/b]: While floating from Carried Away, reactivate to dive downwards and slam all nearby enemies.
[b]Pop-Up:[/b] During The Slip, popping the umbrella will hit all nearby enemies and stop the dash.  [/list][/list]
[h3]Finii [/h3]
[i]Finii is not really winiing so we're reducing her Special cooldown. While we expect this to be an overall buff, we do have bugfixes that will also make the BIG FINISH slightly more fair for opponents to play around.  [/i]
[list]
[*]
BIG FINISH [SPECIAL]

The Core now can escape Big Finish noticeably easier especially when Energy Burst is used

[BUGFIX] No longer slows or vacuums enemies who are EVASIVE

[BUGFIX] Finii ultimate no longer incorrectly holds on to the core when being hit with Energy Burst
[*]
[BUGFIX] Implemented a likely fix to a rare bug where Finii ultimate would crash custom games.
[list]
[*]
If this still occurs, please let us know. [/list][/list][/list]
[h3]Juno[/h3]
[i]We're giving Juno more control over Blobbos, especially for chained hits. The commands to Blobbos have to be made within a tighter window, but Blobbos will also hold the Core for a tad longer while waiting for Juno's command.  [/i]

[*]
Blobbos speed (as a % of Juno's) :: 90% → 100%
[*]
Strike override (Juno's command to direct Blobbo's) linger duration :: .75s → .25s 
[*]
[NEW] :: Juno's Strike cooldown refreshes when a Blobbo uses Juno's strike override direction[/list]
[*]
BLOB BOUNCE [SECONDARY]
[list]
[*]
[BUGFIX] Juno can now consistently strike the Core underneath her while she's jumping[/list][/list]
[h3]Luna[/h3]
[i]Her inventiveness has her more prepared than the average Striker to explore new maps! [/i]
[list]
[*]
B.O.O.S.T. [SECONDARY]
[list]
[*]
[NEW] Now extends duration when teleporting (relevant for Gates of Obscura)[/list][/list]
[h3]Asher[/h3]
[i]Trying to fix more bugs on one of our more... bug prone Strikers.[/i]
[list]
[*]
[BUGFIX] Can now cast primary during her secondary without the ability cancelling
[*]
[BUGFIX] Primary shield has had some bug fixes to prevent the core from going through it. Again. [/list]

[h3][b]GEAR AND AWAKENINGS[/b][/h3]
[h3]Hotshot[/h3]
[i]Even with recent buffs, Hotshot is still more like warmshot.  We're touching it up to really push the pace.  [/i]
[list]
[*]
Core Hit amplifier :: 12% → 15% 
[*]
[BUGFIX] Description updated to include the maximum refund amount[/list]
[h3]Momentum Boots[/h3]
[i]Momentum Boots have been dominating the goalie gear slot for a while. By taking the Speed down a notch, they'll grant less coverage of the goal arc.  [/i]
[list]
[*]
Movement Speed per Stack :: 1.75% → 1.5% 
[*]
Max Movement Speed over 10 seconds :: 22.5% → 20% [/list]
[h3]Primetime[/h3]
[i]The time has been prime for too long.  We're taking serious swings because it was simply the best for too many characters. [/i]
[list]
[*]
Hit Amp :: 5% → 0%
[*]
Hit Reduction :: 0% → 10% (2% for Core)
[*]
Standard recast time between charges :: .5s → 1.5s 
[list]
[*]
Drek'Ar's recast timing is unchanged [/list][/list]
[h3]Strike Shot[/h3]
[i]Accidentally got shortened in 2.3, we're finally bringing it back to its previous glory. [/i]
[list]
[*]
[BUGFIX] No longer unintentionally shorter. Missile speed corrected as well.  [/list]
[h3]Pummelers[/h3]
[list]
[*]
[BUGFIX] Speed buff is no longer lost when another haste effect is applied[/list]
[h3]Monumentalist [/h3]
[list]
[*]
[BUGFIX] Now correctly increases damage and knockback for:
[list]
[*]
Ai.Mi special
[*]
Finii Special
[*]
Asher Special[/list][/list]
[h3]Orbs[/h3]
[list]
[*]
A new set of Orb trainings can be found in Quickplay! [/list]
[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]
[list]
[*]
Ai.Mi Secondary no longer locks her out from using eject button slightly longer than intended 
[*]
Dubu Special no longer sends the Core flying at mach 5 (it'll still go fast, but won't break the Core speed cap)
[*]
Rasmus's and Drek'ar's SECONDARIES are now appropriately tagged as BUFFS (previously just HASTES). 
[*]

Which is exactly what we're doing with some old friends of yours this patch! Most of them are just as you remember, but Stagger Swagger splurged and got a bit of a makeover. [i]Quick Strikes has mostly felt like a niche X pick so we're making it stronger and making it play real nice with other Energy Awakenings. [/i]
[list]
[*]
Energy bonus for strikes :: 1  → 2[/list]

[h2]Matchmaking Adjustments[/h2]
We recently upgraded our matchmaking tools to let us fine tune our matchmaking system to a more precise extent.

Using these new tools, we're rolling out some new matchmaking systems to NA, EU, and JP servers first as a trial to see how it performs on a larger scale.

We'll be looking to eventually use these new tools to improve the matchmaking experience in other regions as well. However, due to regional differences, the changes on other servers will likely be different from the changes below.

To better suit the variety of ranks on the ladder, this system will differ depending on the ranks.
Here's a rough breakdown of what we expect to see per rank:

[b]Omega+:[/b] The matchmaker will wait longer before matching into players below challenger, and generally make it much less likely to match with diamonds and below.

[b]Challenger: [/b]The matchmaker will create fewer lobbies with both Omegas and Diamonds. Instead it will create more lobbies with only Challenger+Omega or Challenger+Diamond. It should also be less likely to match with players below diamond. Queue times on average should be slightly higher as a result.

[b]Diamond:[/b] Similar to challenger, there will be fewer lobbies with both Challenger and Platinum, with more matches dedicated to Diamond + Plat only or Diamond + Challenger only. It should also be less likely to match into players below Platinum. As a result, high and mid-diamond queue times will be slightly longer.

[b]Platinum:[/b] There should be fewer games with players from three different ranked tiers. Queue times should be roughly the same.

[b]Gold and below: [/b] Matchmaking will take slightly longer to find matches as it will spend more time looking for players near your rank.

TL;DR: Matchmaker will take a bit longer to find games, but there should be fewer lobbies with high rank disparity.

[h3]Rasmus [/h3]
[i]The Pendulum has finally swung the other way. After bribing his way into numerous buffs, Rasmus then had the AUDACITY to show off at the tournament stage with his advantaged cooldowns and consistency. We're pulling them back in line. [/i]

We want players who succeed in a draft to always feel like their success matters, which failed too often when the best choice was an Infinite Awakening. Additionally, strategies could become too easy to shut down (via infinite Unstoppable, for instance) or too overbearing (like infinite Stinger). While we want Awakenings to change the experience of the game, the shared choices should only be presented at the beginning of the game so you can plan around them with your picks and bans.  [/i]

notes.title: Omega Strikers - 2.2 Update - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[b]Hello my dear friends and Omega Strikers players! Today's patch is chock-full of quality-of-life updates that a lot of you have been asking for. Things like surrendering, auto-canceling when inactive players are detected, and more. These will help you improve your omega striking experience to become the true omega striker.

BUT WAIT THERE'S MORE! Balance changes to characters, map adjustments, and new awakenings rotated in! Let's get it started.[/b]

[h1][b]SYSTEM CHANGES[/b][/h1]
[h2]GAME[/h2]
[h3]Surrender System[/h3]
[list]
[*]
In Normal and Competitive modes, either team may now surrender during the Awakening Draft phase between sets if they have lost at least 2 sets in the game or have a player on their team that is inactive.
[list]
[*]
"Inactive" in most cases means disconnected from the match, but will also apply to players that haven't made any inputs in 40 seconds of one point.
[*]
Everyone on the team (not including inactive players) must vote to surrender for a surrender to occur.[/list]
[*]
Teams that surrender lose the match and will lose rank as if they had lost normally.[/list]
[h3]Auto Match Cancel System[/h3]
[list]
[*]
If a player is detected as inactive early on into a match, the match will automatically cancel
[*]
A player that causes an automatic match cancellation will be penalized as if they had lost the match. This penalty will also apply to players in their pre-made group they queued up together with.
[*]
Penalties will not be incurred if you/your premade member caused an auto-match cancel and it was the first time within the last 2 weeks.[/list]
[h3]Competitive Mode Integrity Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]
Players above Challenger will no longer be able to enter Competitive mode in a premade group, they must queue up solo.
[*]
Players that solo queue at ANY rank will benefit from higher minimum rating gains if they win a match to balance out cases where they had to fill into a less than ideal match
[list]
[*]
Minimum win rating gains reduced at Challenger tier and above.[/list][/list]
[h3]New Rank Tier - Pro League[/h3]
[list]
[*]
We've introduced a new rank tier: Pro League. Only the top players in each region can qualify to be within the Pro League tier. A player needs to have at least 100 points in the Omega Tier to be promoted into the Pro League tier.
[list]
[*]
That doesn't mean once you hit 100 points in Omega you are automatically added to the pro-league!
[*]
There is a hard limit to the amount of players that can be in the Pro League, so be sure to fight for every LP you can![/list][/list]
[h3]MVP[/h3]
[list]
[*]
There is no longer a multiplier that will weigh events more favorably later in the game for the purpose of determining the end of game MVP [/list]
[h3]Game Content Refund System [/h3]
[list]
[*]
All accounts start with 3 refund tokens that you can use to refund eligible content.
[list]
[*]
Details on how to use the refund system can be found on our support site. [/list][/list]



[h2]MAPS AND MODES[/h2]
[h3]Night Market and Oni Village[/h3]
[i]Doing some maintenance on these maps by making the Speed boosts boost speed a tiny bit more, but largely aimed at making the rules more consistent.  [/i]
[list]
[*]

[*]
Max Core Speed :: 2,000 → 2,100 (now matches previous Night Market max speed)
[*]
Night Market Core speed boost will more consistently grant speed up to the max (2,100) 
[*]
[BUGFIX] No longer will slow the Core down if it's already beyond it's max speed (most frequently happens with Energy Burst into strike) [/list]

[h3]Practice Mode [/h3]
[list]
[*]
You can now head into PRACTICE MODE from the queue selector and practice those sick trick shots[/list]

[h2]Skins/Content[/h2]
[h2][b]STRIKERS[/b][/h2]
[h3]Ai.Mi[/h3]
[i]Our favorite app has gone viral: she's particularly popular and pretty potent. 5 stars.  We're pulling back on how much reach she has, which we suspect will especially tap her down as a goalie. [/i]
[list]

Glitch.Pop [PRIMARY]

Note: Death Touch is still considered a projectile during its initial travel, so it'll will benefit from projectile modifiers such as Missile Propulsion, but transforms into a creation once it expands. notes.notes:
HELLO GAMERS. We've got a little micropatch coming for you with the release of the event: DEMON DUEL. 

Before we get into that, we made some changes to the game that we'd like you to know about. It's important! We're changing things and making them better and different!

Here's Sonii with some of the deets: 

[previewyoutube=JYTXpLGMEGg;full][/previewyoutube]



Here's the FULL deets:


[h2]MAPS AND MODES[/h2]
[h3]Ahten City[/h3]
[i]The map where it all began is now being Awakened into the spotlight as a true competitive staple. With its higher focus on Orbs and (spoiler) synergy with certain Awakenings, we believe it's distinct enough to rise to the occasion.[/i]
[list]
[*]
Now part of the Normal and Ranked map rotation[/list]
[h3]May 17th Micropatch: [/h3]
We nerfed Octavia and Vyce in the May 17th Micropatch. They were just playing their music too dang loud!! Here are the deets if you missed it:
[b]Octavia[/b]
[i]Octavia is intended to be weaker when she's not rolling around at the speed of sound. However, she wasn't feeling particularly vulnerable at lower stagger. She should now be easier to KO and interrupt her Flow State.[/i]

[*]

[h2][b]STRIKERS[/b][/h2]
[h2]Atlas[/h2]
[i]No matter if the strategy is to score or KO, Atlas has tools at his disposal to thwart the attempt.  We're tuning down how often he can use his abilities - and we'll see what he cooks up in his Lab to counter us next.  [/i]

Friend Fling [PRIMARY]

[*]

[h2]Zentaro[/h2]
[i]Zen's gonna pass that test with all the blade studying he's been doing.[/i]

[*]
Oni's Blade [SPECIAL]

[*]

[h2][b]GEAR AND AWAKENING BALANCE[/b][/h2]
[i]Hitting Gear and Awakenings with some light balance changes as data continues to roll in! [/i]
[h3]Magnetized Soles[/h3]
[list]
[*]
Speed :: 30% → 25% (will not be reflected in the tooltip but trust me it's there)[/list]
[h3]Vicious Vambrace[/h3]

[h2][b]AWAKENING [/b]ROTATION[/h2]
[i]We've got ideas for fun and exciting Awakenings that can really change the game and your focus on the round. We don't want a million awakenings always active, reducing your chance of getting stuff you want or stuff that works well together, so we're going to implement a "rotating" system of awakenings. Some older ones are gone, some newer ones are in. That doesn't mean the older ones will be gone forever, you'll see your beloved Prize Fighter again in the future [/i]❤️[i]. The new Awakenings should be enticing to get in every game, but you shouldn't have to ponder taking them on Ahten City where the Orbs are plentiful.  [/i]

notes.title: Omega Strikers - 2.1 Update - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello Strikers! Welcome to the first BIG UPDATE of Omega Strikers. It's been about 3 weeks since we've launched the game to the world, and we already have some more incredible stuff for you all.  We're really out here bringing you TWO new characters, a new map, new Asher, new gear, new bunch of other things too! I also might be biased but the new characters are SUPER fun.
Okay. Sorry. Let's just get into it.

[h1][b]SYSTEM CHANGES[/b][/h1]

[h2]CHARACTERS[/h2]
	
[h3][NEW] Vyce[/h3]	
Vyce is an explosive long-range Striker who uses an electrified guitar to deal heavy damage and warp across the field. She can drop thunderbolts from the sky to stun enemies from a distance, launch chain lightning attacks, and emit a MASSIVE shockwave that sends enemies flying. With Vyce, it's all about finding the perfect moment to warp into your enemies and start melting their faces with a ripping guitar solo. 	
[list]	
[*]	
Thunderstruck [SECONDARY]	
[list]	
[*]	
Summon a thunderbolt from the sky to a target location, hitting and stunning enemies for .75s. For the next 3.25s, recast to assume a form of pure energy and teleport to the cast location.[/list]	
[*]	
Power Chord [PRIMARY]	
[list]	
[*]	
Launch a lightning riff, hitting and slowing the first target struck before chaining LIGHT hits to nearby opponents. [/list]	
[*]	
Super Nova [SPECIAL]	
[list]	
[*]	
Push-and-hold this ability to start rocking out, gaining 100% knockback resistance.  Upon releasing the ability or after 2.5s, emit a shockwave that blasts enemies away from you. The wave increases in size and power for the first 1.25s it's charged.[/list][/list]	
[h3][b][NEW] Octavia[/b][/h3]	
Octavia is a speedy but fragile Striker who excels at controlling the core and evading enemy attacks with her pair of psychically-controlled speakers. Her entire playstyle is built around Flow State, which grants her a scaling speed boost that refreshes its duration whenever she hits something. To become a true virtuoso with Octavia, you'll need quick reflexes and a focused mind in order to continually extend your Flow State for as long as possible.	
[list]	
[*]	
Flow State [SECONDARY]	
[list]	
[*]	
Gain 25% Speed for 2.75s, increasing by 2.5% per second. Hitting anything refreshes the duration, scaling infinitely.	
[*]	
Sonic Boom [PRIMARY]	
[list]	
[*]	
Launch a sonic wave that hits all targets it passes through and slows them for 1s. Deals light hits to subsequent targets.[/list]	
[*]	
Bass Drop [SPECIAL]	
[list]	
[*]	
After a delay, emit 5 sound pulses over a short duration that hit surrounding enemies.[/list][/list][/list]	
[h3]Asher - Mini-rework[/h3]	
Asher's kit was too oppressive at keeping the Core forward, which made it very frustrating for opponents when trying to counter her core control. We're removing her passive shield barrier and moving that to the duration of her PRIMARY ability cast only. If she casts PRIMARY on her side of the field, her barrier will be larger and unbreakable. We think these changes, along with a defensive buff to her SECONDARY, will improve her tank-like playstyle. All of these changes should improve counterplay against opposing Asher forwards, but we'll be keeping a close eye on how she performs as a Goalie as well. Does that fit the criteria for a "mini-rework"? You tell me!


[list]
[*]Striker Barrier (STRIKE)
[list]	
[*]	
Passive Barrier Creation on ability casts :: Removed	
[*]	
Now is just a normal Strike[/list]	
[*]	
Breakthrough [SECONDARY]	
[list]	
[*]	
Fixed a bug where Asher could move during the channel time of the dash (0.125s channel before dash)	
[*]	
Tuned to be more forgiving to hit units slightly in front of and behind her 	
[*]	
Now grants Asher a BUFF that reduces incoming Knockbacks by 30% and damage taken by 25% for 5 seconds. This buff loses its effects if Asher is staggered.[/list]	
[*]	
Barrier Beam [PRIMARY]	
[list]	
[*]	
Renamed from Arc Beam to Barrier Beam	
[*]	
[NEW] Creates a barrier while cast that deals a LIGHT hit to enemies it comes in contact with before breaking. If cast on Asher's team's side of the field, the barrier is [b]larger and unbreakable [/b]for its duration. 	
[*]	
Asher is no longer further slowed if the barrier hits something (she is still slowed while channeling)	
[*]	
Beam Range :: Increased from 340  → 350[/list][/list]
[h3]Era[/h3]	
[list]	
[*]	
Magical Maelstrom [SPECIAL]	
[list]	
[*]	
Maximum knockback angle to the cast direction :: 90 degrees → 60 degrees 	
[list]	
[*]	
This will keep both the Core and knocked-back players moving in the direction of the Maelstrom, instead of it being all funky.[/list][/list][/list]	
[h3]Juno[/h3]	
[list]	
[*]	
Strike with Friends (STRIKE)	
[list]	
[*]	
[BUGFIX] Blobbos will now reset their overridden strike direction when Juno strikes the Core	
[list]	
[*]	
This should make it easier for Juno to set up some pass plays with the Core[/list][/list][/list]	
[h3]Rasmus[/h3]	
[list]	
[*]	
Pendulum Swing [PRIMARY]	
[list]	
[*]	
[BUGFIX] The head of his chain sickle (circular area) now scales with increased size[/list][/list]	
[h3]Rune[/h3]	
[list]	
[*]	
Unstable Anomaly [PRIMARY]	
[list]	
[*]	
[BUGFIX] Now scales at a fixed rate, instead of being slowed down by increased Creation Duration	
[*]	
[BUGFIX] Will knock back targets multiple times if they stay inside the Anomaly [/list]	
[*]	
Banish [SPECIAL]	
[list]	
[*]	
[BUGFIX] Now banishes additional targets hit for the same amount of time as the first target.[/list][/list]

[h3]X[/h3]	
[list]	
[*]	
[BUGFIX] Base strike size: 350 diameter -> 270 diameter
[/list]

[h2]MAPS AND MODES[/h2]
[h3][NEW] Demon Dais[/h3]
[list]
[*]
Our first brand-new map! It pairs perfectly with the Oni twins of Ahten.
[*]
On this new music stage, we have a unique Barrier setup with two concentric circles that you have to break through. On breaking the outer barrier, the speakers on the sides of the map activate, pumping out sonic waves! These waves will push Strikers and the Core away from them. When the inner barrier on either team drops, the speakers get amplified, expanding the impact of the sound waves further into the map!! You might want to bring earplugs. [/list]
[h3]Ahten City [/h3]
[list]
[*]
Now spawns 6 Orbs per wave instead of the standard 3
[list]
[*]This is intended to give Ahten City a little bit of variety and have a unique feel to it, rather than it just being the "standard" map. We've got a couple things in the future brewing around Ahten City as well, so keep your eyes peeled for that![/list][/list]

[h3]Night Market[/h3]
[list]
[*]
[BUGFIX] Speed gate now grants bonus to all units within its area when it is activated.
[*]
[BUGFIX]On being hit by the Core, barriers take the standard 1s to fully deactivate (was shorter to match previous visuals)[/list]
[h3]Oni Village[/h3]
[list]
[*]
[BUGFIX] Speed zones now better match the visuals and do not extend into the corners. [/list]
[h3]Tutorial[/h3]
[list]
[*]
Updated to better teach players how to aim their Strike and Abilities with controllers and on mobile 
[*]
Default setting for Controllers now has Aim Guidance turned off, letting players aim with their movement stick (Left Stick)
[*]
[BUGFIX] Goal gates now meet in the middle instead of appearing slightly open during tutorial
[*]
[BUGFIX] Goal gates in tutorial will no longer disappear when they're closed in the tutorial[/list]
[h2]POWER ORBS[/h2]
[list]
[*]
Healing :: 20% of Max Stagger → 7.5% to 30% based on current stagger (more healing when more damaged)[/list]
[h2]UI and other improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*]
More Striker info on lore page
[*]
Improved layout in lore book
[*]
Barriers now have a VFX on destruction
[/list]
[h2]COSMETICS[/h2]
We've gone and added all those cute and cool skins we made from the first Creator VS. They're cool. And cute.
We also made some super rad stuff for the Ahten City Music Festival!!!! Be sure to check these out 8)

[h3]Creator Skins[/h3]
You might've seen 'em shared by us before, but they're finally here!
[list]
[*]
Moist Asher
[*]
Rakin Juliette
[*]
Lily Juno Bee[/list]
[h3]Music Skins[/h3]
The Oni twins aren't the only ones ready for the music festival! A couple of your other favorite Strikers are getting into the groove:
[list]
[*]
Idol Ai.Mi
[*]
Pop King Kai
[*]
Soundwave Atlas[/list]
[h3]Goal Explosions + Emotes[/h3]
What's a music festival without a little visual effects? We threw in a nice new goal explosion and a couple emotes into the patch, just to take this concert to the next level.

[h2]Consoles[/h2]
[h3]Nintendo Switch[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Now playable at 60FPS![/b]
[/list]
[h3]Xbox[/h3]
[list]
[*] No longer requires Xbox Live Gold to play
[list]
[*] This was actually fixed a week or so ago, but I'm including it here anyway 8)
[/list]
[/list]
	
[h2][b]GEAR [/b][/h2]

[list]
[*]
[NEW FORWARD GEAR] Siphoning Wand :: Hits deal bonus damage equal to 5% of the enemy's max Stagger over 2.5s, healing the user for the same amount. 
[*]
[BUGFIX] Fixed an issue where gear benefits would sometimes be lost when if goalies ventured to the very edges of the map.  [/list]
[h3]Pummelers [/h3]
[list]
[*]
25% bonus knockback to staggered targets → now grants 10% more knockback to all targets[/list]
[h2][b]BUGFIXES[/b][/h2]
Making a video game is hard. We ran into some bugs, but we squashed some bugs too! Here's a couple in particular that we squashed. Thank you for all your diligence in reporting them!!
[list]
[*]
iOS Users should no longer experience massive framerate drops when they take Tempo Swing awakening.
[*]
End of match screen in non-English languages no longer shows weird debug text.
[*]
Omega Strikers no longer crashes Nintendo Switch when playing in 60 FPS!
[*]
Core, goal gates, and goal barriers no longer disappear when dead.
[*]
Fixed an error that repeatedly caused players to fail to connect to games during the loading screen.
[list]
[*]
THIS ONE IN PARTICULAR IS REALLY NASTY. It will likely still occur on consoles, so if this keeps happening to you, PLEASE let us know! [/list]
[*]
Battle pass icon has been updated to show Season 2 content.
[*]Atlas Lab Recharge time indicator is now red instead of green. Just an additional warning that you should get away from the area instead of trying to pick it up because it [i][b]will [/b][/i]explode.
[*]
Various other small bug and crash fixes.[/list]

[h2]Controls[/h2]
[list]
[*]
Fixed a bug on Gamepads where quick casting a cast at location movement ability on certain settings would cast directly at your Striker's feet instead of at maximum range.
[list]
[*]
Affects:
[list]
[*]
Juno Secondary
[*]
Estelle Secondary
[*]
Ai.mi Secondary
[*]
Zentaro Special[/list][/list][/list]	

[h1]Micropatch Update - 5/17/2023 - v 2.1.1[/h1]

The Oni Twins are blasting music and enemies alike - they made their rock star, pyrotechnic fueled entrances, but we’ve quickly seen that you can rage too hard and too fast.  We’re slowing their roll so they can continue to rock at a more reasonable win rate. 

[h2]STRIKERS[/h2]

[h3]Octavia[/h3]

Octavia is intended to be weaker when she’s not rolling around at the speed of sound.  However, she wasn’t feeling particularly vulnerable at lower stagger. She should now be easier to KO and interrupt her Flow State. 

[list]
[*]Stagger Gain Over Levels :: 250 → 125


[*]Flow State [SECONDARY]
[list]
[*]Increased speed per second :: 2.5% → 2% 

[*]Duration :: 2.75s → 2.5s 
[/list]


[*]Sonic Boom [PRIMARY]
[list]
[*]Cooldown :: 7.5s → 8s

[*]PvP Damage and Knockback :: 175 (+87.5% Power) → 160 (+80% Power)

[*]Core Knockback :: 1330 (+175% Power) → 1300 (+160% Power) 
[/list][/list]
[h3]Vyce[/h3]

Vyce is always down for an encore, but her long sets gave opponents too little counterplay. She’ll end her riffing a bit earlier now so Evades are more feasible.  

[list]
[*]Thunderstruck [SECONDARY]
[list]
[*]Cooldown :: 14s → 16s 
[/list]

[*]Super Nova [SPECIAL]
[list]
[*]Max Hold time: 2.5s → 2s (time to fully charge unchanged at 1.25s)
[/list][/list]
